title: DATA ARCHITECT H/F
description: DATA ARCHITECT M/FScope of action and main responsibilities: You have solid expertise in Data technologies, engineering and data modeling. Your great technological curiosity and your proven ability to adapt quickly to all developments make you a professional eager to contribute to the development of a new strategic activity within a company focused on innovation and ambition. Join Hardis Group! Within our Services Business Application entity in Grenoble, we are continually strengthening our teams to consolidate our know-how in Data. As part of the expansion of our Services activity, Hardis Group is actively looking for a Data Architect (M/F) to strengthen our Grenoble teams. As an expert, you will work on various missions such as consulting, expertise, technical audits, process mapping, definition of Roadmaps and Data architectures (Cloud/On premise), assistance with choice tools, PoC/MVP, coaching/training, etc. You will also contribute to pre-sales activities in close collaboration with our team of business engineers. Participating in the recruitment of young data talents, qualifying them and guiding them in their career plan will be an important part of your role. You will take an active part in their training and their skills development. You will also be involved in technological monitoring and innovation, leading the BA Grenoble data community with the help of your peers and your manager. As an option, you have the possibility of assuming a People leader role, directly supervising 5 to 10 people. Required qualifications: Required skills: - At least 8 to 10 years of experience, including technical and consulting missions. - Excellent knowledge of Data architectures (Cloud/On premise). - Mastery of ETL and a dataviz tool at least. - In-depth knowledge of different models. - Importance given to belonging to a team. - You are comfortable in English and French, both written and spoken. Your autonomy and technical curiosity will allow you to take on new challenges and provide solutions. Listening and communication skills, as well as strong adaptability, are essential for this position. Finally, a team spirit will be a decisive asset to convince you of your integration at Hardis. Have you read the description but you seem to be missing one or two skills? It is also our job to help you increase your skills and support you in the development of your career. For our part, in addition to being part of this great adventure, we offer you: - A permanent position, with a long-term mission - Follow-up in your mission and the prospect of having new ones in management or in an agency - Participation in agency events such as our LABS, our quarterly agency days, our agency evenings and afterwork! - A friendly and caring atmosphere - A very good work/life balance (time flexibility, 2 to 3 days of teleworking per week possible) - A training system adapted to your skills development - An active CSE locally and a real strategy CSR - And in addition: Advantageous mutual insurance, participation bonus and profit-sharing, restaurant tickets of €8.50 / day covered at 60% by the employer, reimbursement of the transport subscription at 75%. Why us? Consulting company and IT services company, Salesforce integrator and software publisher for logistics, Hardis Group has set itself the mission of accelerating the transformation of commerce, the supply chain and information systems, in particular thanks to cloud technologies. Its 1,235 employees support the strategic, organizational and technological transformations of companies throughout Europe, in order to develop their competitiveness, productivity and attractiveness. The company articulates its CSR strategy around three pillars: reducing the environmental footprint of its activities and those of its customers, diversity and equal opportunities as well as integration through education. Through its HardisGroup Academy , Hardis Group offers a system to develop the skills of its employees. In 2021, each employee benefited from an average of 3.5 training sessions, face-to-face or remotely. Hardis Group achieved a turnover of 132.7 million euros in 2021. The company is located in Grenoble (head office), Paris, Lyon, Lille, Nantes, Bordeaux, Madrid, Utrecht and Warsaw. If you don't believe in chance either, we certainly have a long way to go together!

You are proactive, innovative, curious, and bold. You are willing to understand, challenge and support our business needs. To work in a fast moving, learning and collaborative environment You are looking for opportunities to develop and grow. description:
IT and InfrastructureEMBL Heidelberg



 

EMBL is looking for an enthusiastic Senior IT Systems Engineer – Core Infrastructure Services to join the IT Operations team!

Continuous improvement of our IT infrastructure and support process based on the needs of EMBL users and stakeholders


Apply now
Closing date: 31 October 2024



Contract duration: 3 years (renewable up 9 years)

Reference number: HD02657




Related

View all EMBL jobs
Sign up for job alerts
View openings from partners





 

You have

A degree in computer science or equivalent
At least 5 years professional experience in managing (integration, automation and monitoring) a medium to large-sized heterogeneous IT environment
Experience in using technologies such as NetApp (NFS/SMB), IBM TSM, MySQL, Cisco ESA, LDAP (OpenLDAP/FreeIPA/389 DS), Zabbix, FreeRADIUS, Ansible, VMware
Familiarity with protocols like DNS, DHCP, SMTP, IMAP, SQL, AAI (LDAP, RADIUS, SSO)
Solid experience in Linux system administration
Advanced Perl/Python/Shell scripting skills
Basic knowledge of networking and IT security
A service-oriented attitude, good communication skills and excellent knowledge of English




 

You might also have

German language skills




 

Why join us
Do something meaningful
At EMBL you can apply your talent and passion to accelerate science and tackle some of humankind's greatest challenges. EMBL conducts world-class excellent biological research, provides advanced training for students and scientists, and provides state-of-the-art technologies for a wide range of scientific and experimental services.
Join a culture of innovation
This is a highly collaborative and inclusive community where our employees enjoy a relaxed atmosphere. We are committed to ensuring our employees feel valued, supported and empowered to reach their professional potential. We are located in Heidelberg, a scientific hub in Germany and home to several internationally renowned research facilities adjacent to its world-famous university. Heidelberg is also a popular tourist destination due to its romantic city scape, including the Heidelberg Castle, the beautiful Baroque old town, amongst others.
Enjoy lots of benefits

Financial incentives: Monthly family, child and non-resident allowances, annual salary review, a comprehensive pension scheme, death benefit, long-term care, accident-at-work and unemployment insurances
Flexible working arrangements
Certified training and continued development of your professional and personal skills
Private medical insurance for you and your immediate family
Generous time off: 30 days annual leave per year
Relocation package including installation grant (if required)
Campus life: subsidized canteen and cafeteria, on-site library, casual dress code, extensive sports and social club activities
Family benefits: on-site nursery, 10 days of child sick leave, generous parental leave and monthly family and child allowances
Benefits for non-German newcomers: Visa exemption, education grant for private schooling, financial support to travel back to your home country every second year and a monthly non-resident allowance




 

What else you need to know

International applicants: We recruit internationally, and successful candidates are offered visa exemptions
The working language of the institute is English
Diversity and inclusion: At EMBL, we strongly believe that inclusive and diverse teams benefit from higher levels of innovation and creative thought; therefore we welcome all individuals to apply
Job location: This role is based in Heidelberg, Germany. You will be required to relocate if you are based elsewhere, and you will receive a generous relocation package to support you
How to apply: To apply, please submit a cover letter and a CV through our online system

title: PhD Position F/M Ecological and economic logistics service network design: Models and Decision Support Algorithms
description: A propos du centre ou de la direction fonctionnelleThe Inria University of Lille centre, created in 2008, employs 360 people including 305 scientists in 15 research teams. Recognised for its strong involvement in the socio-economic development of the Hauts-De-France region, the Inria University of Lille centre pursues a close relationship with large companies and SMEs. By promoting synergies between researchers and industrialists, Inria participates in the transfer of skills and expertise in digital technologies and provides access to the best European and international research for the benefit of innovation and companies, particularly in the region.For more than 10 years, the Inria University of Lille centre has been located at the heart of Lille's university and scientific ecosystem, as well as at the heart of Frenchtech, with a technology showroom based on Avenue de Bretagne in Lille, on the EuraTechnologies site of economic excellence dedicated to information and communication technologies (ICT).Contexte et atouts du posteThis PhD thesis is part of the collaboration between INRIA and LOG'ISSIMO, a company of the French national postal service provider, La Poste. In what follows, the main challenges faced by LOG'ISSMO are described, and the thesis proposal is detailed in order to address some of them. Context As a result of the digitalization of exchanges, La Poste, like all postal operators, is facing an inexorable decline in its traditional mail business. Therefore, a key challenge for La Poste is to find new sources of growth in order to maintain and develop its business. LOG'ISSMO's strategic business area is in the B2B (business-to-business) logistics sector. It is the delivery of goods to professionals, with volumes ranging from 3 parcels to 3 pallets. LOG'ISSIMO offers efficient first- and last-mile logistics solutions for small and large companies and local authorities. Its network is made up of 76 logistics platforms and 13,500 daily routes, enabling it to transport more than 35 million shipments a day. LOG'ISSMO's development poses challenges in terms of structuring and supporting the growth of the business. In addition to scaling up its processes and resources, LOG'ISSIMO faces major challenges in clarifying its own logistics model, particularly with a view to combining it with La Poste's historical logistics activities. There are many strategic questions to be answered that could benefit from decision support in a number of areas, including system performance:  Manage the logistics network as effectively as possible. LOG'ISSIMO's offer is based on logistics terminals that were originally designed to sort mail and manage parcels, rather than more voluminous items. Therefore these infrastructures have to be modified so that LOG'ISSIMO can operate its logistics business efficiently. The question primarily concerns terminals both in terms of locations and of the overall service network in France. It also concerns the means of transport and their Reduce CO2 emissions at the lowest total cost. In order for Log'issimo's offer to be a success, the various services offered have to be consistent with La Poste's historical positioning and to be able to differentiate LOG'ISSIMO from the competition, by integrating the energy efficiency into all LOG'ISSIMO activities. Analyze and anticipate existing and/or potential break of bulk points via new customers or new services. Via our management tools and information systems, any logistics activity needs to be managed using appropriate performance indicators. Based on the logistics solutions identified, the challenge is to determine the most relevant KPIs for managing this new logistics activity.  The scope of the study covers the whole of France over a 3-year period.Mission confiéeThis thesis aims to answer three main questions: i) How can we design a logistics network that is both economically and ecologically efficient? ii) How can we adapt this network to new demands (location of products, transportation routes)? iii) What KPIs should we define, given solutions proposed by decision-support methods, to effectively manage the network? The problems addressed in this thesis belong to two classes of transportation optimization problems. At a tactical level, it is similar to a logistics service network design problem (Belieres et al (2021), Belieres et al (2022)). In this problem, a logistics operator seeks to determine where products in a logistics network are stored so as to fulfil customer orders efficiently. The logistics network to be designed is a cost-effective multi-level distribution network, which includes the different types of warehouses and customer sites. As the distributed products are in small quantities compared with vehicle capacities, consolidation is an effective strategy for reducing transport costs. Specifically, it involves routing products in such a way that vehicles carry multiple products at the same time, each of which may come from a different site and be destined for a different customer. At the operational level, this is a vehicle routing problem with pick-ups and deliveries (Parragh et al (2006), Koç et al. (2020)). This problem consists in elaborating a set of routes from a logistics platform to satisfy a set of transport requests characterized by a pick-up point and a delivery point for the goods. After the mathematical modelling of the problems, the thesis work will focus on the development of heuristic approaches combining artificial intelligence and mathematical programming techniques. One of the main challenges in this thesis will be to solve these problems for the very large instances provided by LOG'ISSIMO in reasonable computational times, especially when considering new transport demands given an initial situation. References Belieres, S., Hewitt, M., Jozefowiez, N., & Semet, F. (2021). A time-expanded network reduction matheuristic for the logistics service network design problem. Transportation Research Part E: Logistics and Transportation Review, 147, 102203. Belieres, S., Hewitt, M., Jozefowiez, N., & Semet, F. (2022). Meta partial benders decomposition for the logistics service network design problem. European Journal of Operational Research, 300(2), 473-489. Koç, Ç., Laporte, G., & Tükenmez, İ. (2020). A review of vehicle routing with simultaneous pickup and delivery. Computers & Operations Research, 122, 104987. Parragh, S. N., Doerner, K. F., & Hartl, R. F. (2006). A survey on pickup and delivery models part ii: Transportation between pickup and delivery locations. Journal für Betriebswirtschaft, 58, 81-117.Principales activitésThe work plan for this thesis will be as follows: First, a comprehensive state of the art on the problems of logistics service network design and route planning with delivery and collection will be realized. This state-of-the-art will allow us to take advantage of the models and methods developed in the literature and to position the project in relation to existing studies. Second, ad-hoc mathematical models will be developed, taking into account the specificities of the case proposed by LOG'ISSIMO, and then, heuristics combining artificial intelligence and mathematical programming techniques associated with the models will be designed, implemented, and evaluated Finally, key performance indicators will be developed on the basis of the solutions provided to companies to enable system management.CompétencesTechnical skills and level required : Good knowledge in combinatorial opimization, integer programming, heuristics Coding: C++, JavaAvantages   Subsidized meals Partial reimbursement of public transport costs Leave: 7 weeks of annual leave + 10 extra days off due to RTT (statutory reduction in working hours) + possibility of exceptional leave (sick children, moving home, etc.) Possibility of teleworking and flexible organization of working hours Professional equipment available (videoconferencing, loan of computer equipment, etc.) Social, cultural and sports events and activities Access to vocational training Social security coverage

title: Librarian focus young people and accessibility

title: Business manager for Stockholm
description: Stockholm Intern Ledning Visionite is the IT consulting company with 100% focus on the employee, where life balance permeates everything we do. We are proud to have been named Sweden's best workplace, Sweden's best employer, and Career company in both 2023 and 2024. The most important personality trait we look for in our employees is kindness - a quality we value most in the organization. We want to be and work with kind people. With the industry's best offering for senior IT specialists, over 450 employees and the strongest growth in the industry, we are on an exciting journey forward. With us, you get to be part of a fun stage of this journey, as an individual, as a team and as a company. We at Visionite Stockholm like to create results together. We work as a team in everything we do, in both ups and downs, while having a lot of fun along the way (and of course we celebrate all successes big and small!). We are a group with a strong competitive spirit and high business understanding who love to build long-term relationships with people, both IT specialists and customers. Together, we want to build the world's best and kindest IT consulting company that creates real life balance while delivering the highest quality to our customers. Who are we? Visionite is one of Sweden's fastest growing IT consulting companies. We were founded in 2018 in Umeå and are today in 17 different offices around Sweden. The Stockholm office opened in 2020 and since then has had strong growth where we went from 0 to 100 million in turnover and we have no plans to slow down that pace. We currently have a total of 87 employees. We create real life balance for our senior IT specialists and with our unique offer we succeed in attracting the very best. When we recruit, we look for people who have a high level of technical ability, consultativeness, personality and who are kind people! What will be your responsibility? Your main focus as Business Manager with us will be to build relationships with both IT specialists, customers and partners. We are still a relatively small company that we are building together, which means that your responsibility will be broad and it is therefore required that you are unprestigious and confident enough to be able to both empty the dishwasher, recruit new senior IT specialists, have competence development talks with your business unit , plan together a consulting event such as conducting a price and contract negotiation with a customer or partner. Your days will simply vary, but that is also precisely what makes the role of Business Manager both developing, challenging but above all very fun. Your responsibilities include, among other things: Search for your next colleagues, attract, recruit and find the right assignments for our senior IT specialists. You will mainly do this over the phone and you have our industry-leading offer to help you, but it will still place high demands on your ability to communicate, convince and quickly build trust. Have managerial responsibility over senior IT specialists and hold continuous employee interviews linked to both well-being and motivation in the role of consultant as well as continuous competence development and interview coaching. Take care of all administration connected to your IT specialists such as purchasing new work tools, time reporting, invoicing and contract management. Have daily contact with both customers, partners and suppliers. Even though we are a team, you will be responsible for your IT specialists coming out on the right assignment and at the right price, which places high demands on your ability connected to sales and building strong relationships. Have a strong focus on the business. Our task is to find the right skills and then find the right assignment, which is a constant puzzle and it places high demands on your ability to connect this. Together with the team, manage continuous consulting activities, which can mean everything from curling, Escape Room, joint training, Christmas and summer parties, code nights or a simple AW.  We don't like to throw ourselves around with lots of titles, but we have all chosen to call ourselves Business Managers, as everyone within our sales and delivery organization has the same responsibility and goal, to build Stockholm's best IT consulting company together. We will have high demands on your will to succeed in the role, but will of course give you the right tools along the way and a clear introduction to both the company and the role. Who are you? As previously mentioned above, it will be your attitude, will and personality that will be decisive for you to succeed in the role of Business Manager with us. But it is also impossible to avoid the fact that we work in a complex industry with high competition, which places high demands on your ability to both sell and build strong relationships with customers while at the same time being a safe and trust-inspiring manager for our senior IT specialists. So, in addition to the above personal abilities, we would like you to have: Previous experience from a role with a strong sales and delivery focus where you had many contact points with customers with a responsibility from appointment booking to signed contracts Experience from the IT consulting industry or a similar industry where you had a lot of contact with candidates and gained an understanding and knowledge in IT What do we offer? In addition to a very fun and challenging role and of course extremely nice colleagues, we offer you an office with by far Stockholm's best view from the 21st floor of the DN-skrapan, the chance to be part of building the company, annual conference trips, great development opportunities, flexible working hours, individual salary setting with fixed + variable part, good benefits and a great focus on life balance.  Do you feel this matches who you are and what you are looking for but want to know more? Don't hesitate to contact Emelie Karlsson at emelie.karlsson@visionite.se or via LinkedIn, https://www.linkedin.com/in/emeliek/ and we'll talk more.

title: Database Administrator

title: Amanuenses for computer science VT 2025, 15-25 pieces.
description: Umeå University is one of Sweden's largest universities with over 37,000 students and around 4,700 employees. At the university, there is a diversity of high-quality education and world-leading research in several scientific fields, and here the ground-breaking discovery of the gene scissors CRISPR-Cas9, which was awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry, was made. At Umeå University, everything is close. Our cohesive campuses make it easy to meet, collaborate and exchange knowledge, something that favors a dynamic and open culture. The societal transformation and the large green investments we see in northern Sweden create enormous opportunities and complex challenges. For Umeå University, it is about conducting research about - and in the middle of - a society in transformation. But also about delivering education for regions that need to expand quickly and sustainably. This is simply where the future is created. Are you interested in knowing more? https://www.umu.se/jobba-hos-oss/om-universitetet-som-arbetsplats/BeskrivningThe Department of Computer Science has approximately 170 employees from around twenty countries and is in a strong expansion phase. We conduct education and research within a broad spectrum of the computer science field, and offers education at basic level, advanced level and postgraduate level. Close to 2,000 students study with us from 14 different programs, which corresponds to 460 full-time students. We are now looking for assistants and the positions are between 15-50%, 3-6 months in the spring of 2025. The deadline for applications is 2024-11-07. Job duties The job as assistant means that you will be employed by the university and teach practical aspects. This can involve tutoring with individual students in a computer room or via digital tools such as Zoom, but also group exercises where you work with exercises with student groups of 30-40. It often also includes assessment of the students' mandatory tasks and planning and evaluation of the course together with the teaching team on the course. Courses where we currently have a need for supervisors are (number in parentheses):- 5DV037 Fundamentals of Computer Science, 0-1 pc - 5DV086 Programming language, 1-2 pcs - 5DV149 DoA C reading period 3, 7-8 pcs - 5DV149 DoA C reading period 4, 4-5 pcs - 5DV150 DoA Python reading period 3, 5-7 pcs - 5DV150 DoA Python reading period 4, 1-2 - 5DV171 Operating system , 1-2 pcs - 5DV186 Distributed systems, 0-1 pcs - 5DV202 Introduction to databases, 2-3 pcs - 5DV204 DV2: Algorithms and problem solving, 2-3 pcs - 5DV221 Imperative programming (C), 3-4 pcs - 5DV226 Interaction technology, 2-3 units - 5DV230 Object-oriented programming, 5-6 units - 5DV239 Applied algorithmic problem solving, 0-1 unit - 5DV209 Mobile applications, 1 unit Exact needs vary between courses, some courses need a lot of equipment and some may be staffed with other staff but we list them all so that you can indicate which course(s) you want to work on. Note that you must be at least at the same level in your own studies as the course you are supervising. Qualifications To be able to work as an amanuens, you must currently be studying in the education that the courses are aimed at, i.e. study an education program at the Faculty of Science and Technology. You must have completed your own studies with a minimum grade of 3/Pass on the course you want to supervise and have time to spare for the amanuens work. This means that you should be able to show that you have largely completed your studies at a normal pace of study and do not have too many uncompleted courses. It is also advantageous if you have leadership credentials, e.g. from sports teams, the corps, confirmation camps, etc. A great merit is if you have worked as an amanuens before (with us or at another institution). Those who apply for an amanuens position and have the competence to supervise several courses will be hired before those who can only supervise single courses. Great importance will be placed on personal qualities. Conditions The employment is between 15-50% for 3-6 months during the spring term 2025. You will be introduced and trained in your duties by experienced staff at Computer Science. When you perform your duties, you usually collaborate with amanuenses who have already worked for a term. Application In your application, we want you to: - Attach a short description of yourself and why you would be suitable as amanuense. - Tell me if you worked previously as an amanuens and if you then worked on the courses you want to work on now or not. - State which courses you would like to participate in and prioritize which courses you would most like to supervise - State to what extent you would like to supervise (3 or up to 6 months, 15-50%). - Attach a summary of your studies and also indicate which courses you plan to study in spring 2025. Contact For any questions, please contact Jan Erik Moström, jem@cs.umu.se. We look forward to your application! Umeå University wants to offer an equal and equal environment where open conversations between people with different backgrounds and perspectives lay the foundation for learning, creativity and development. We therefore welcome people with different backgrounds and experiences to apply for the current position. To staffing and recruitment companies and to you who are sellers: We kindly but firmly refrain from direct contact with staffing and recruitment companies and sellers of further job advertisements.

title: Service engineer for BTG Instruments AB Mälardalen
description: Imagine a job where you get the chance to work with world-leading technology. You get the opportunity to learn how each product works, both theoretically and practically, as well as to ensure that all equipment works optimally in the customer's process. If this sounds interesting, the position as a service engineer with us at BTG Instruments is something for you. About BTG Instruments AB BTG Instruments AB is a world leader in measuring and analysis instruments for monitoring and regulating advanced process parameters in the paper and pulp industry. For over 100 years, we have developed innovative and cost-effective solutions to improve the productivity and profitability of paper and pulp processes. BTG was founded in 1921 in Sweden and today has its headquarters in Éclépens, Switzerland. Globally, we consist of approximately 600 employees and have been owned by Voith Paper GmbH since December 2019. What does the role of service engineer with us mean? We are looking for a motivated and knowledgeable service engineer who wants to join our Nordic team. In this role, you will provide lifecycle and aftermarket services for our BTG instruments, which are used in the pulp, graphics, packaging and tissue industries. This is a hands-on role where you will mainly work with mechanical, electrical/electronic and computer/software related tasks. As a service engineer, you are responsible for fulfilling our service agreements, from planning and implementation to reporting on work performed. Assignments include installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, instrument exchange and performance optimization. You are also responsible for customer training when starting up new equipment as well as technical support when needed. Although you often work independently, you have access to a large network of engineers within BTG, who are there to support you. Additional responsibilities include: Carrying out certain service via BTG Smart Monitoring System to carry out predictive analyses, advice and calibration. Keep up to date on the status of installed products and suggest improvements in consultation with our sales department. Manage your own spare parts inventory and document services and key information in reporting systems. Identify sales opportunities during customer visits and drive sales initiatives. You will work from home, preferably in southern Sweden or in Mälardalen and travel frequently to customer locations, mainly in Sweden and sometimes in other parts of Europe. The position includes approximately 65% ​​presence with customers, and you get access to a company car and compensation for a home office. You are also offered a bonus based on sales targets. What are we looking for in you? We are looking for you with technical understanding in mechanics, automation and/or electronics. Experience with computer hardware is a plus. You are good at building relationships and like to collaborate with colleagues and customers. You work independently, are driven and have an analytical and solution-oriented attitude. We expect you to follow safety regulations and laws, and that you can drive and finish projects. A technical education and experience in instrument engineering work or similar are meritorious, as is experience in paper and pulp processes. You will receive the necessary training and product training upon employment. As we are an international group, good knowledge of both English and Swedish is required. What do we offer? At BTG, we value entrepreneurship, new ideas and personal responsibility. We work actively to develop our staff and give you as a service engineer a valuable understanding of our products, which provides opportunities for further development in other roles. Why join us? BTG values ​​diversity and inclusion. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and offer opportunities for professional development. The pulp and paper industry offers rewarding challenges, and we are looking for individuals who want to contribute to our customers' success and sustainability goals. In this recruitment, we are collaborating with Technogarden. Apply via the ad on technogarden.se. Due to GDPR, we cannot accept applications by email. Selection takes place continuously, and the position can be filled before the application period has expired. For more information about the position, contact: Dario Villaman 070-601 79 96, dario.villaman@technogarden.se Warm welcome with your application!

title: Staffing Coordinator
description: About FuruhöjdenFuruhöjden is a private care company that consists of four operations; Rehabilitation, Rehab Center, General Practitioner's Office and Corporate Health. Our vision is to be a personal and seamless choice for health, care and rehabilitation. Our philosophy is to provide person-centered care and rehabilitation, always with the individual at the center. With us, we collaborate with colleagues across different areas of expertise and thus help individuals maintain and regain their health and quality of life. We believe in minimizing contact surfaces and culverts in healthcare so that the individual receives exactly the general care, specialist care, counseling and rehabilitation that he or she needs. We call it personal and seamless care - our vision. Furuhöjden Rehabilitation is one of the largest providers of inpatient rehabilitation after emergency care in the Stockholm Region. Recently, we have started specialized neurological rehabilitation after treatment in an emergency hospital and have previous agreements with Region Stockholm in orthopaedics, thoracic surgery, general surgery and planned neurology. We have 44 care places. Nurses, assistant nurses, rehab assistants, physiotherapists, occupational therapists, counselors, doctors, dietician, kitchen, cleaning and administrative staff work with us. At Furuhöjden, we have short decision-making paths and work closely together to achieve the business's goals together. We have present managers, HR and CEO who all sit in the same building as the business to increase the opportunities for good collaboration and open communication. About the position For our rehab units, we are now looking for a staffing coordinator. As a staffing coordinator with us, you have the main responsibility for the daily staffing - you cover urgently arising gaps based on our staffing key and the needs of the business. As Rehabilitation is a 24/7 operation, the need for staffing is large and we strive for high staff density to meet the needs of our guests and maintain a good working environment. You are also responsible for the long-term planning of staffing linked to, for example, holidays, parental leave and longer sick leave. Your daily tasks include, among other things, receiving sick reports via email, covering sick gaps and registering any deviations in the schedule. You will work in our scheduling system, Planday, where you will ensure that schedules and shifts are entered correctly and register new employees. As we use staffing staff when necessary, the work also includes contact with staffing companies. You are responsible for ensuring that hourly employees and temporary staff have access to the schedule, codes, login information and information regarding introduction. As a staffing coordinator, you are the link between the department heads and the employees when it comes to scheduling and possible absences, you work closely with them to ensure Furuhöjden's staffing achieves the best possible degree of coverage. You are helpful in planning the introduction of new employees and the recruitment of part-time staff for the summer. This role also includes developing and improving working methods and routines linked to staffing. About you We are looking for you who have a burning interest in high service and administration. You take initiative and enjoy working in a role where you both have a lot of personal responsibility and work independently while being flexible and collaborating with different professional roles. You find it easy to create good relationships and are always treated well. In order to achieve a schedule that ensures the requirements of the business, patient safety and a good working environment for our employees, it is also required that you have a structured way of working, that you can quickly find solutions, prioritize and have a good ability to see the big picture. As an applicant, you should have a very good knowledge of data and systems, we like that you have experience with a scheduling system and that you have previously worked with staffing. If you have experience from a service profession and have worked with administration, we believe that you can succeed and thrive in this role. You will belong to the HR team at Furuhöjden, which currently consists of 3 people. The work as a staffing coordinator can vary in intensity as certain periods have greater staffing needs than others, it is therefore required of you who are applying that you have a good ability to adapt your pace to the needs of the business. You should also, in order to fit well into this role, be communicative and have a good ability to work according to organizational goals. Furuhöjden's watchword is; positive, caring, professional, unpretentious and creative. This is something we work actively to comply with, and of course we see that you, as an applicant, also feel that you can stand behind our values. We also attach great importance to personal qualities. Requirements Very good IT/data skills Experience of service profession and administration Good language skills in Swedish, both spoken and written Good knowledge of MS Office High school education Merit: Experience of staffing within 24/7 operations Experience of staffing - and scheduling system, preferably Planday Experience in the care sector Conditions We have a collective agreement through Almega/Vårdföretagarna and apply individual wage setting. We also have a wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year and an occupational pension. Working hours Mon-Fri starting at 7.30. The position is permanent, we apply a 6-month trial period. Selection and interviews take place continuously.

title: The Swedish Customs Service is looking for an IT specialist for crime-fighting operations
description: The Customs Service's IT department in Luleå is northern Sweden's largest IT employer, with around 290 employees. With us, you get to work with the latest technology and participate in development in several exciting business areas. Together with colleagues who complement each other, you solve new tasks every day and contribute to the Swedish Customs Service's socially important mission. The Swedish Customs Service is growing and our IT department in Luleå is looking for an IT specialist with a focus on security systems - apply and become one of our new employees! About the position The crime-fighting area is in an expansive phase and needs to be strengthened with IT specialists. As an IT specialist, you will work with system management and certain development together with others where you jointly responsible for managing a number of the Swedish Customs Service's IT systems that support the law enforcement activities. Your main duties are within administration and include troubleshooting, configuration, user support, minor task management and some further development from requirements collection to introduction into production. The work involves collaboration in various forums within the Customs and the IT department but can also be against other authorities. We build long-term teams that accumulate knowledge in their respective delivery areas and they therefore contribute greatly both to the Customs' operations and to the benefit of society. Are you who we are looking for? We are looking for you as have an academic education in IT or other education/experience that the employer deems equivalent as well as a good ability to express yourself well orally and in writing in Swedish. You have also worked with system administration within IT. It is meritorious, i.e. it is good to know this but not a requirement, if you have experience with integration management, Windows and Linux environments, JavaEE, JBoss application server, and agile development methods.Personal characteristics As a person, you are initiative-taking, curious, quality conscious, communicative and without prestige. You are results-oriented and have a holistic perspective in everything you do. You find it easy to collaborate with others while being able to work independently. You are also comfortable collaborating remotely and use all channels and tools for that. For you, the Customs Agency's core value is; Holistic view, Innovative thinking, Taking responsibility, something completely natural. We attach great importance to personal suitability! We offer you An exciting and stimulating job with good development and training opportunities, where the Customs Service has an important mission in society. The Customs Office is a recognized friendly workplace where we value well-being and culture very highly - having fun at work is a success factor. By working at the Swedish Customs Administration, you contribute to a safe and secure society. We think it is important to have balance in life, and therefore our benefits include, among other things, something we call a flexible workplace. This means that you work both at the office in Luleå and from home based on a level that suits the business. With us, you get secure employment conditions and benefits that include, among other things, a flexible workplace, with the possibility of certain home work, health care allowances and good holiday and pension conditions. working at the Swedish Customs Administration, you contribute to a safe and secure society.Other Reference number: TV-2024-21016.Location: Luleå. and privacy awareness. Before a decision on employment, you will undergo a drug test and background check. A security check with a register check according to the Security Protection Act is carried out before employment, as the position is placed in a security class. The Customs Service is a total defense authority and upon employment, you may be assigned to the Customs Service. The Customs Service values ​​the qualities that are brought to the operation by having an even distribution of gender and ethnic diversity. For more information and application If you have questions about the position, please call recruiting manager Linda Persson, tel. 079-062 14 39. For questions about the recruitment process, you can call Customs' PA support, tel. 060-67 25 85. Union representatives are OFR-P/TULL-KUST, Anders Nilsson tel. 0920-25 96 31 and for Saco-S, Eva Rutberg, tel. 0920-25 96 39. Your application with an accompanying personal letter and CV/résumé in Swedish must have been received by the Swedish Customs Service by November 4 at the latest. You apply via the electronic application form below. We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies as well as sellers of job advertisements. Customs is a government authority that controls the flow of goods across Sweden's borders. With the vision that only approved goods should cross the border, we prevent illegal goods from entering the country and contribute to a safer society. We simplify trade with other countries and lay the foundation for increased growth and competition on equal terms. The customs office, which was founded in 1636, today has approximately 2,600 employees and is led by Director General of Customs Johan Norrman.

title: CAD and Simulation System Administrator IT
description: Join a supportive and dynamic team contributing to software that significantly impacts Epiroc's success! We provide a welcoming workplace where colleagues from diverse cultures come together to collaborate, share perspectives, and reach new goals.   Your mission As a System Administrator IT at Operations Solutions, you will play a vital role in ensuring the reliability and efficiency of essential IT tools and applications. Your team manages tools like PTC Creo, AutoCAD, and Ansys, working closely with teams handling the Product Lifecycle Management tool Teamcenter. These tools are used daily by our end-users at Epiroc.   In this role, you'll be part of a collaborative CAD and Simulation team, working on preventive maintenance and contributing to continuous process improvements. You will listen carefully to business needs and support the quality enhancement of our systems.   Your responsibilities will include configuring CAD and Simulation software, ensuring seamless integration, managing response times, and resolving incidents or issues that arise. You will work closely with the team's Product Owner to understand the needs of end users, translating them into actionable requirements for license management and software usage within the team's portfolio. Close cooperation with other teams in the Operations Solutions department will be essential, as will your communication with end users to understand and meet their needs.   Together with the IT organization, you will help manage server environments, maintain network security, and oversee data storage systems. You will assist in the installation, configuration, and updating of hardware and software, while offering thoughtful troubleshooting when technical issues occur. As part of the team, you'll support the development and implementation of IT policies and procedures, with a focus on optimizing system performance and ensuring data integrity and confidentiality. It will also be key to document IT processes and systems clearly and thoroughly. This role calls for an understanding of various operating systems, databases, and cloud services.   Your profile To thrive in this role, you bring a solid knowledge of IT systems as they relate to the tasks mentioned above. You have experience with CAD and Simulation applications and servers.   A degree in Information Systems, Network Systems, Computer Science, or similar relevant experience is preferred.   You are accustomed to working in environments where end users rely on your guidance and are comfortable with troubleshooting and system maintenance.   As a person, you are service-oriented and focused on delivering high-quality results by proactively identifying areas of improvement, reporting any issues, and contributing to the ongoing development of our products. You are a strong communicator and view collaboration as one of the most rewarding aspects of your work.  Your problem-solving abilities, organizational skills, and attention to detail are crucial in this role. Strategic thinking and documentation skills are also key attributes.   Since our teams are international, fluency in both spoken and written English is essential. Proficiency in Swedish is an advantage, but not required.   Location  This position is located in Örebro, Sweden.    Life at Epiroc   By joining our team, you can expect an atmosphere of creativity, innovation, and workplace diversity. You will be a part of a group of skilled and helpful colleagues who live by our core values: Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation. We work in a global environment with over 113 different nationalities!  In addition to the fact that we have a culture that is characterized by development combined with having a good balance between work and leisure, there are some things that makes us a little extra proud to work at Epiroc:     Global career opportunities   Epiroc University, for your own competence development   Community involvement   Benefits package, which amongst other things include flexible working hours and bonus.     A hybrid workplace   Life at Epiroc can include the possibility for a hybrid workplace. It is a way of working that offers flexibility and participation allowing for a better balance between work and private life, which also promotes well-being. The hybrid workplace is an opportunity if work allows, based on your role, responsibilities, and individual conditions.    Application and contact information   Apply for this position by creating an account in our recruitment system.  Last day to apply is 2024-10-30.   In this recruitment process we review applications continuously and we may close the process before the last application day.  Please note that due to regulations, we cannot handle applications received through email.   For questions about the position please contact hiring manager: Gabriel Smith, Manager PLM Engineering, CAD & Simulation - Operations Solutions, Gabriel.smith@epiroc.com   For questions about the recruitment process or application please contact:  Lovisa Torbacke , Recruitment specialist, Lovisa.torbacke@epiroc.com   We have already made our choices regarding advertising channels and consulting providers, and kindly request not to be contacted regarding such inquiries. Epiroc is a global productivity partner for mining and construction customers, and accelerates the transformation toward a sustainable society. With ground-breaking technology, Epiroc develops and provides innovative and safe equipment, such as drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment and tools for surface and underground applications. The company also offers world-class service and other aftermarket support as well as solutions for automation, digitalization and electrification. Epiroc is based in Stockholm, Sweden, had revenues of more than SEK 60 billion in 2023, and has around 18 200 passionate employees supporting and collaborating with customers in around 150 countries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com .

title: IT security architect
description: Apply here! Are you passionate about IT and cyber security and want to work with exciting tasks in an environment where Sweden's economic development is the focus? As an IT security architect, you will work broadly with IT security issues to ensure that the Riksbank's IT security capabilities and cyber resilience develop in step with the ever-changing threat landscape. The Riksbank's IT environment contains several systems critical to society and we make high demands on those who want to work with us, but at the same time we offer the opportunity to work, grow and develop in an environment that few can match!For the Riksbank, IT and cyber security is a very important area . IT is the business's strategic partner and has high ambitions to be at the forefront with competence, IT support and cyber security. As an IT security architect, you will contribute to the further development of the Riksbank's IT and cyber security in line with the rapid change in the outside world. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development of the Riksbank's IT security architecture and run security projects with the aim of expanding and improving the security of the Riksbank's IT environment. As an IT security architect at the Riksbank, you work broadly with IT security issues. In your role, you set requirements, evaluate and document new or changed solutions based on the needs of the business. You act as support to both IT and the business in matters relating to IT and cyber security. Furthermore, you are responsible for further developing and managing the Riksbank's IT security architecture as well as collaborating with operating suppliers and other stakeholders in architecture matters. You organize and lead workshops around requirements and solutions and ensure that strategy and guidelines for IT architecture are followed and developed. The work also includes environmental monitoring within IT security, which may involve participation in international forums. In your role, you also contribute to developing strategies in the IT security area and strengthen the business's awareness of IT security risks. You have a strong understanding of the needs of the business and contribute with your experience and knowledge as well as act as an expert and advisor in IT and cyber security issues including IT security architecture and cloud security. If necessary, you also act as a project/activity manager. The Riksbank's IT operations are led by an IT manager and consist of four units. You belong to the Unit for architecture, IT security and e-krona where you will work closely and in collaboration with other IT security architects, IT security manager, SOC manager, penetration testers, security analysts, system managers, IT architects, the business and the Riksbank's suppliers. To be successful in the role, you have a university or college education in computer science, systems science or equivalent knowledge you have gained through work. You have several years of practical experience working with IT security architecture and requirements in the IT security area. You have very good knowledge of various cloud solutions and their security functions, knowledge of IAM (Identity Access Management) and applicable laws and regulations in the area. Experience with relevant frameworks such as e.g. ISO 27000 and NIST CSF. Work in the public sector, operation and management as well as competence in IT infrastructure, networks and operating systems (UNIX and Windows) are also meritorious. You have good collaboration skills and are used to documenting and presenting. You can discuss technical issues and solutions both with technical specialists and with people without technical knowledge. IT and cyber security is very important within the Riksbank and you should therefore have worked as an IT security architect in an organization where these issues are in focus. It is advantageous to have experience in risk management, continuity planning and requirements towards suppliers. As a person, you have the ability to take a holistic view and a genuine interest in IT security issues. You have very good analytical skills, work in a structured way and are self-motivated. You take initiative and are goal- and result-oriented. You also have good communication skills, communicate and write fluently in both Swedish and English. We would like you to have a relevant certification in the field, for example CISSP, CCSP, CCSK or equivalent. Qualifications Requirements: • University or higher education in computer science, systems science, alternatively work experience that we consider equivalent. • Several years of practical experience in a similar role as IT -architect in cyber security.• Experience of working with cloud security, IT security architecture and requirements in the IT security area.• Good knowledge of cloud solutions and their security functions.• Good knowledge of IAM (Identity Access Management).• You can discuss technical issues and solutions both with technical specialists and with people without technical knowledge.• Good Swedish and English in speech and writing. Meritorious:• Experience of relevant frameworks such as e.g. ISO 27000 and NIST CSF.• Work in the public sector, operation and management as well as competence in IT infrastructure, networks and operating systems (UNIX and Windows).• Experience in risk management, continuity planning and requirements towards suppliers. Relevant certification in the field, for example CISSP, CCSP, CCSK or equivalent.Responsibilities• Set requirements, develop, evaluate and document new/changed solutions based on the needs of the business.• Support IT and the business in matters relating to IT and cyber security. • Further develop and manage the Riksbank's IT security architecture.• Support and collaborate with the Riksbank's operating supplier and other stakeholders in matters relating to IT security architecture. • Organize and lead requirement and solution workshops.• Ensure that strategy, governing principles and guidelines for IT architecture are adhered to and continuously developed.• Monitor the environment in the area, which may also involve participation in certain international forums. title: Examensarbete - IT Sustainability Inventory
description: Now you have the chance to dive deeper into the cutting edge of technology and environmental responsibility. Our thesis, "IT Sustainability Inventory," explores how IT departments, with the help of vScope, can adapt to the EU's taxonomy and actively contribute to corporate sustainability goals. Are you ready to shape the sustainable IT strategies of the future? Apply now for a unique opportunity to combine technical expertise with environmental commitment! Who are we looking for? For this degree project, we are looking for you who are a master's student in civil engineering with a focus on economics, sustainability, IT, and/or business administration. You should have a strong interest in technology, such as software development, IT or data analysis. You are an entrepreneurial person who has the attitude that nothing is impossible and has the ability to work both independently and in a team. Your creative problem-solving skills and your commitment to sustainable development will be crucial in this project. Degree project: IT Sustainability Inventory- How can companies' IT departments develop and implement routines and strategies to reduce their environmental impact? Background: We are in a time when sustainability and environmental impact are central issues for companies in all industries. With the introduction of the EU's taxonomy (https://www.regeringen.se/regeringens-politik/finansmarknad/taxonomi-ska-gora-det-enklare-att-identi...) companies have been given guidelines and a classification system to demonstrate their impact in sustainability issues. These changes mean both challenges and opportunities for IT departments. The challenge lies in navigating and integrating these new sustainability requirements into the existing business. This means a careful review of how IT resources are used and managed, as well as an adaptation of IT strategies to ensure that they are in line with the company's overall sustainability goals. At the same time, this opens up opportunities. By adapting to the taxonomy, IT departments can not only reduce their environmental impact but also contribute to the company's overall sustainability goals. It also provides a chance to rework and improve existing IT systems and processes to become more energy-efficient and cost-effective in the long term. Our product, vScope, is the market's leading solution for IT inventory. It streamlines and facilitates a range of daily tasks within IT departments, including security, license management, reporting, compliance, invoicing and lifecycle management. By gathering all important information in one place, vScope enables users to create detailed reports, documentation and improve collaboration across the organization. But, can we widen its scope of use further? Purpose: This thesis aims to explore how the EU's taxonomy and other relevant external and internal requirements affect the work of IT departments, with a particular focus on sustainability. The project aims to identify both challenges and opportunities for IT departments to effectively contribute to the company's sustainability goals through advanced inventory and reporting. Examples of questions: How does the EU's taxonomy and other regulations affect IT departments' work processes and decision-making in sustainability-related issues? In what ways can IT departments develop and implement routines and strategies to reduce their environmental impact, in line with the EU's taxonomy? Which tools and methods are effective for measuring and following up the IT department's environmental impact and their contribution to the company's sustainability goals?  Do you think this sounds interesting? Take the chance to become the architect behind the sustainable IT solutions of the future. With vScope as your toolbox and your passion for technology and sustainability, there is an opportunity for you to become part of our journey towards a more sustainable digital future. The vScope platform is able to collect, relate and visualize information from any technology in the data center - in one single view. With full historical traceability of any data, vScope adds completely new perspectives and values ​​when trying to work with something that we can't see. We offer opportunities for people to grow. At InfraSight Labs, you will play an important role, not only by contributing to our business and our products, but also by being part of building the company, the team and our culture. title: Coordinator for the night patrol

You will also participate in meetings and gatherings and act as administrative support to the business manager. Your background We are looking for you who have post-secondary education in, for example, administration or another specialization that the employer deems relevant to the position. We see that you have experience in qualified administrative work. The work requires that you have good oral and written knowledge of Swedish. You also need to have knowledge of various IT systems such as Heroma, Phoniro, Lifevare and Microsoft 365. As a coordinator, you need to have a B driver's license as you will also handle the cars that the night patrol uses. As a person, you are service-oriented, calm, attentive and accommodating in your treatment. You are a good analyst and are good at seeing context and solve complex questions and problems. Furthermore, you understand financial relationships and the factors that lead to a business with balanced finances. The job suits you as a flexible person who has the ability to see opportunities in changes. Last but not least, you are good at structuring, planning and prioritizing your work. Employment can only take place after verification of work permit, which is required according to the Aliens Ordinance. About our organization Welcome to the care and social care administration. We work with support and care for the elderly and people with disabilities. The goal is for them to be able to live as active and independent a life as possible. The Health and Care Administration is one of Sweden's largest employers in municipal care and care. Around 7,500 employees work here based on our values ​​- make a difference, work together and welcome innovation. With us, there are great opportunities to take personal responsibility, develop and contribute with your skills. We strive for an organizational culture with mutual trust and pride in the business. You can find more information about what it's like to work in Uppsala municipality at Work in care and care - Uppsala municipality (https://www.uppsala.se/foretag-och-arbete/jobb-och-karriar/jobba-hos-oss /work-within-care-and-care/) Within the care and care administration, we have full-time as the norm. title: IT Security Coordinator
description: Svenska kraftnät is one of the most important actors for a sustainable energy transition. As an IT security coordinator, you are offered one of Sweden's most important IT jobs, in which you will contribute to Sweden's electricity supply every day. We need you to succeed in our socially important mission to electrify Sweden. We are currently around 500 people in IT and we will grow further in the coming years. This is to be able to create the conditions for Sweden to be able to double its electricity production and reach the climate goals by completely switching to fossil-free energy. In order to succeed, we will use the latest technology to increase the capacity of our infrastructure and at the same time increase the pace of development around systems, digitization and processes. If you want to work and develop in a growing organization and together with wonderful employees create a forward-looking and robust IT organization, apply for the position as an IT security coordinator with us! About the service As an IT security coordinator, you support project and management organization with knowledge in IT security. The role involves a large variety of tasks, which requires a good ability to find new solutions to challenges. In the role of IT security coordinator, it is important to be well updated both regarding the current threat picture and relevant regulations, standards and best practices in the area. Examples of tasks as an IT security coordinator:• Coordinate the IT security work in projects and management, for example by coordinating and addressing IT security-related issues with other relevant parts of the authority. • Act as an expert in IT security architecture and requirements regarding IT and information security. • Provide support in handling IT security incidents and related issues. • Coordinate periodic analyzes of the IT and information security in the systems, for example risk and vulnerability analysis and participate in security reviews and gap analyses. You will belong to the IT security support unit tasked with support programs, projects and management organization regarding processes and methodology linked to IT security and provide technical expertise in the same area. The unit is divided into four IT security teams that support in all areas of Svenska kraftnät's complex IT environment, such as in system development, client-side systems, IT infrastructure, OT security and facility-related infrastructure at our power stations. With us, the IT security work is carried out proactively through, for example, support for projects and management, but sometimes also reactively if there has been an incident or other unwanted event. About youPersonal characteristics We are looking for you who have good collaboration skills and are easy to create new relationships as this role involves many contact points in the organization. To be successful, we see that you are results-oriented and work structured. You have an ability to effectively seek solutions to problems and challenges in the IT security area. We attach great importance to your personal properties. Requirements You have a degree in IT or have equivalent competence acquired in another way. You also have • Relevant work experience in IT with a focus on IT security (at least 5 years' work experience) either in IT operations, IT development, IT projects, IT administration or IT continuity. • Work experience from setting requirements and follow-up in the IT security area. • Solid knowledge of IT security, including the latest trends and tools. • Been involved in both operational and strategic IT security work. • Very good ability to express yourself verbally and in writing in Swedish and English. We see it as meritorious if you have • Knowledge of container technology, for example Docker, Podman or OpenShift. • Knowledge of tools linked to system development. • Been involved in IT development projects or system development. • Knowledge of IAM technology and standards • Work experience from the energy industry • Certification in IT / IT security Good to know • The position is located in Stockholm/Sundbyberg. • Possibility of remote work up to 50%. • The application deadline is 13 November 2024. We do not accept personal letters in connection with your application. • The position is a permanent position. Feel free to contact recruiting manager Tobias Andersson (tobias. andersson2@svk. se), 010 350 90 93 or responsible recruiter Victoria Waltenberg, 010 350 90 45. Union representatives are Annika Ingeborn, SACO, 010 475 87 72 and Mikael Hedenheim, 010 475 84 68. You can also reach us by e-mail: first name. surname@svk. see. #LI-DNIOther informationWe place high demands on our employees' security and privacy awareness. Before a decision on employment is made, a security assessment will be carried out in accordance with the Security Protection Act (2018:585) in cases where the position involves the handling of security classified information or participation in security-sensitive activities. If the employment concerns a position in a security class, the security clearance will also be required to include a register check and, in some cases, a special personal investigation. Swedish citizenship is required for employment at Svenska kraftnät. With the employment comes an obligation to be deployed. title: IT-specialist
description: About the Nordic Museum: The Nordic Museum is about being human. Our real stories, objects and environments reflect how life in the Nordics is shaped through meetings between people and in interaction with nature and the climate. From the present all the way back to the 16th century. Today, the Nordic Museum's collections constitute a unique treasure of voices and memories from the Swedish and Nordic cultural heritage. Among other things, through 1.5 million objects, 6 km of archival material, 6 million photographs, over 400 cultural-historical buildings, environments, parks and gardens, fishing waters, forests, agriculture and hunting grounds. But we don't stop there. As a museum, we stand in the middle of cultural history, and with posterity constantly in mind, we continue to collect and document the present and people's life experiences for future generations. We believe that knowledge of life yesterday gives perspective today and strength to future generations. What does the job as an IT specialist entail? We are now looking for you who want to work as an IT specialist with us at Nordiska the museum with the task of ensuring the daily operation of our systems and contributing to future-proofing our IT infrastructure. You will work both on operational tasks and participate in strategic initiatives to improve and develop our technical environment. As an IT specialist with us, you belong to our Business Support department which, in addition to investigators, also consists of roles within IT, HR, Real Estate, Procurement and Security. Your closest team consists of two colleagues in IT, but you will also work in close collaboration with the rest of the organization. Examples of tasks are: Operation and maintenance of the museum's VMware environment Administration in MS Azure Operation and maintenance of physical and virtual networks. Create and update documentation, instructions and management plans for the museum's IT systems and infrastructure. Ensure that suppliers meet set requirements for service levels, documentation and key figure reporting Provide technical support to colleagues and users. You will respond to support cases, help with troubleshooting and provide guidance on various IT-related issues. Who are we looking for? In order to thrive in the role of IT specialist with us, we see that you have experience in similar work and are used to working both operationally and strategically. Your previous experiences and characteristics: Post-secondary education in IT At least 5 years' experience as an IT technician in a larger organization. Good knowledge of VMware and configuration in virtual server environments Good knowledge of administration of MS Azure's platform services, SSO and Office365 Very good knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS and digital certificates Experience of configuration and troubleshooting in complex networks Good knowledge of Swedish and English, as well as speech as in writing It is advantageous if you have experience in: Working according to ITIL processes Onboarding, MS Entra/Intune and program distribution Planning and implementation of physical and virtual networks Experience in administration in Defender and Microsoft Exchange Administration of firewall clusters IT operation in public environments It is not only about what you previously did in your working life. In our recruitment process, we attach great importance to your personal qualities. For this particular role, we are looking for someone who: Is used to working independently but who also enjoys collaborating You have a natural sense of responsibility and value taking responsibility for your work Good analytical skills Other qualities we believe characterize you are strong problem solving skills and that you are a good communicator with a pedagogical approach What do we offer? We are approximately 140 people who work together to offer inspiring experiences, important exhibitions and cultural-historical perspectives with the help of objects and stories from our collections. With us you get: employment with safe working conditions and skills development, the opportunity to work in a meaningful workplace with an important social mission together with stimulating and developing tasks benefits in the form of discounts and free tickets, health care allowance, occupational pension, possibility of salary change and healthcare and medicine costs to name a few. opportunity to work in one of Stockholm's most iconic buildings Scope and location: The position as an IT specialist is a full-time position located at Djurgården and is a permanent position with an initial trial period of 6 months. Access takes place as soon as possible or according to agreement. Questions regarding employment are answered by head of department Staffan Agesand, via staffan. agesand@nordiskamuseet. see. Union questions are answered by Thomas Adolfsson (SACO) or Ylva Alriksson (OFR) on tel. 08-519 546 00 (VXL). Application: Does the above sound exciting? Then we want to know more about you! A warm welcome with your application, but no later than November 8. Applications with selection and interviews are handled continuously, so don't wait with your application. Please note that we do not accept applications by email. We uses a competence-based recruitment with your personal qualities in focus. We want our workplace to be a reflection of society and strive for diversity, therefore we invite all qualified candidates to apply for the position. title: System engineer within application
description: The county boards' IT department is in an exciting development phase where digitalisation, innovative solutions and security and preparedness issues are in focus. Our IT environment is extensive and varied. It includes everything from modern infrastructure to systems that we develop ourselves. Above all, our ideas benefit society as a whole. It gives a very special feeling that is hard to beat. The county boards' activities are very broad and operate in areas that are highly relevant in today's society. Digitization is a strong driving force for the county administrations, where IT often plays a key role in realizing the needs. The county boards' IT department is national and works for all 21 county boards in Sweden. Our offer Are you a committed systems engineer who wants to be involved in developing and managing digital solutions that contribute to societal benefit? Do you thrive in an environment characterized by team spirit and the opportunity to develop together? Do you also have experience in Microsoft IIS, certificate management and integrations? Then you can be our new colleague! As a systems engineer within application, you work with application operation of client-server and web applications. You work with lifecycle management and updates. Furthermore, you set up, troubleshoot, document and maintain the functionality of the applications. You have a close collaboration with the developers regarding requirements that exist for the development of applications. You belong to a team where teamwork and cooperation are keywords and you have great opportunities to develop together with us. In this role, you work with challenging and developing assignments together with committed and available colleagues. You get an employer with a focus on a community service to be proud of. Here you have an opportunity to work with technical solutions that affect the whole of society. Our unit, Application Support, is responsible for the development and management of systems, integrations and application platforms. We build tomorrow's administrative and development organization where strong teams lead, operate and deliver IT support to the County Boards' assignments. We are always developing our business and you therefore need to be open to the fact that your duties may also change over time. Location is primarily Gothenburg, Mariestad, Vänersborg, Karlstad or Luleå. Placement in another location may be possible by agreement. We offer flexible work with good opportunities for remote work part of the working time. Qualifications You have: - a university education in the IT field or work-related experience that is considered equivalent - good experience working with Microsoft IIS, certificate management and integrations - used to working with Windows server (2019/22). We would like you to have: - experience with AD, Networks and Virtualization - experience with PowerShell, Python, Databases or Windows 11 - experience working as a technician in a management organization where you worked in e.g. the PM3 model. Personal characteristics In order to enjoy and succeed in the role of systems engineer, we are looking for you who are self-motivated in your way of working. You take responsibility for your task, structure your working day yourself and drive your tasks forward. You take initiative, start activities and achieve your goals together with the team. You are good at collaborating and we take it for granted that you contribute to a good working climate. As our colleagues are spread out in many places in Sweden, we work to a very large extent with digital meetings, and the virtual way of working is something you enjoy. You can easily learn and adopt new technology, and take responsibility for constantly monitoring the world around you to keep yourself up to date. We attach great importance to personal suitability. We believe in equal opportunities for everyone and one of our main missions is to work for diversity and a staff composition that reflects the county's population. Good to know Welcome with your application! We would like it to be in Swedish, which is our working language. https://www. the county board. see/vastra-gotaland/about-us/work-with-us/work-at-the-it department. html you can find more information about what it is like to work at the County Boards' IT department. We place high demands on our employees' security awareness. Security review according to the Security Protection Act (2018:585) will be carried out before we make a decision on employment. Swedish citizenship may therefore be required for some jobs. Read more about security clearance https://sakerhetspolisen. see/data protection/data protection measures/personnel data. HTML. The employment may begin with a 6-month probationary period. We have chosen recruitment channels and do not want to be contacted by recruitment companies. Your application becomes a public document when you apply for services with us. Therefore, it is important that you with protected personal data do not register via our recruitment system. Mail your application to the HR unit, Länsstyrelsen Västra Götaland, 403 40 Gothenburg. Don't share any sensitive ones information in your application but provide some form of contact information so that we can contact you if you are suitable for the position. If you have any questions, please contact HR via e-mail hr. vastragotaland@lansstyrelsen. see
