We have a vision to enhance important moments in people's lives and as Sweden's leading department store chain, we have the opportunity to really make a difference. We are now looking for an experienced system administrator to join our team at Operations to develop and manage services, applications and processes within the portfolio. We offer In the role of Application Manager, you become part of our Operations team responsible for Åhlén's logistics solutions from supply planning, manual and automated warehouse solutions, transport solutions to supplier portals, POS and ERP. Together with the team, you are responsible for monitoring and managing smaller applications within Åhlén's portfolio, including PLM (Product Lifecycle Management), CRM (Customer Relationship Management), WMS and EDI (Electronic Document Interchange). Examples of tasks: - Manage and develop the services, applications included in the portfolio. - Be the company's contact person in daily questions regarding the systems you work with. - Act as support for incident management of the systems. - Participate in projects involving the various systems You will be part of the IT Operations team and will collaborate both with the team and with stakeholders for the various systems within the entire organization. Who are we looking for? In this role, new challenges appear on a daily basis, therefore we see that you are proactive and have a great drive to find solutions and improvements. You are curious about learning new things, are analytical and understand the needs of the business. As you will work cross-functionally and have daily contact with other functions within the organization, you appreciate and enjoy working in teams. For this role, we also see that you have:- Experience of a similar service where you have worked with development and system management of EDI solutions- Experience of logistics, supply and ERP systems are meritorious The position is a full-time temporary position for 1 year with a good chance of extension. We would love for you to start with us as soon as possible. You are placed at Åhlén's head office located at Dalagatan 100, a walk from Odenplan. The position may be filled before the application deadline, so submit your application today! As an Application Manager at Åhléns, you will be part of a passionate team driven by business acumen and entrepreneurship. We give you confidence and the opportunity to grow in a developing environment. With that, we warmly welcome you to Åhléns! The Åhléns family business was founded in 1899 in Insjön and is today one of Sweden's strongest brands, with 47 department stores in Sweden and e-commerce via åhlens. see. Åhléns is the natural meeting place, which gives the customer added value and inspires new discoveries and meetings, as well as offering an engaging mix of quality brands in clothing, interior design, children's items and beauty. Åhlén's turnover 4.7 billion and every year our approx. 3,000 skilled employees receive 60 million visitors. Åhléns Outlet and Designtorget are subsidiaries. www. ahlens. see

description: Job Description Do you want to be part of shaping the IT infrastructure of the future within one of the Nordics' leading logistics companies? In the role, you also get the opportunity to act as project manager for large and small projects related to IT infrastructure in Sweden, Denmark and Finland. You are part of a team of eight people located in different countries in the Nordics. Together you are part of the group's DTS department (Digital Technology and Security) with a total of approximately 100 employees. In the role, you have the opportunity to work from Stockholm, Gothenburg, Jönköping and Helsingborg. Your most important tasks: Participate in designing, planning and implementing IT solutions Support central IT (Digital technology and Security) in troubleshooting prioritized incidents Handling of incidents, requests, problems and changes related to IT - Infrastructure in Sweden, Denmark and Finland Act as project manager for projects related to IT Infrastructure in Sweden, Denmark and Finland We are looking for you who recognize you in the following description Relevant IT technical training or equivalent in project management with a focus on IT infrastructure. Experience of working with infrastructure and communication equipment. Experience with production technology equipment, for example vehicle-mounted PC clients, android equipment, PDAs and applicator/label solutions. You also have experience with the products' associated applications. Experience with automation systems, sorting facilities' IT systems and peripheral equipment is a merit Ordering and coordination skills. Good ability to run and execute projects. Good understanding of the connection between technology and IT. For you to succeed and enjoy the position, we are looking for you who is a good team player, who creates trust and commitment. You have a burning interest in new technology and see every problem as an opportunity to improve. Taking responsibility and being "service minded" towards your employees and for deliveries is obvious to you. As a person, you work independently but also function freely in a group. You have a strong systematic approach with the habit of creating routines and documenting your work. What can we offer you? We offer you a position where you are in constant development. With us, you get room to shape your everyday life and career. We believe that when those who work for us develop, so does the entire group. With us, you become part of a strong competence environment with pleasant colleagues Posten Bring strives to be at the forefront of society and market development. Therefore, it is important that we see solutions where others see problems and dare to try things that others do not dare. We offer competitive terms and good insurance and pension benefits If you have questions about the position, please contact hiring manager Veronica Nilsson at: veronica. nilsson@bring. com If you have questions about the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact responsible recruiter Sebastian Gille-Johnson at: sebastian. gille-johnson@bring. comDiversity at Posten Bring is our strength, and we believe that diversity among employees is the key to new thinking and innovation. title: Architecte Infrastructure Cloud AWS F/H (2024-112419)
description: Description of the offer Are you interested in the world of IT and new technologies? Would you like to contribute to the success of the digital transformation of the EDF Group? Join the dynamic and passionate team of the Infrastructure and Cloud Services Department of the IT-O Directorate of the DSIT! One of the 5 groups in this Department is the SPOC group (Services , Portal and Cloud Orientations) of 20 employees. It works in particular to make IT-O services more reliable and promote, strengthen animation around collaborative tools, manage the automatic supply portal and support Business IT departments on the public cloud. The Public Cloud represents a major part of the EDF Group's digital strategy , bringing agility, innovation and autonomy. As an AWS Cloud Infrastructure Architect, you are the architect of the reference infrastructure base for this provider, responsible for the architectures and the EDF landing zone, alongside the System Architect of the DSIT Public Cloud service chain. As such, you will be required to: - Develop the technical roadmap of the AWS landing zone for the Public Cloud Train and the EDF Datacenter&Cloud program, in collaboration with the Product Owner in AWS architecture, on various subjects such as application, network, security, storage, etc. ;- Participation in Maintaining Operational and Security Conditions of the AWS base and implementing part of the selected solutions;- Manage technical documentation (Technical Architecture File, Project Files design, Operations File) and ensure the link with the CCOE teams for AWS; - Carry out, write and present technical-economic studies to the collective or EDF IT decision-makers; - Lead and participate in meetings of the collective of architects AWS from EDF in order to share and capitalize on the practices of the Company and peers; - Represent EDF in events such as the AWS Summit Paris; - Ensure technological monitoring and transmit knowledge on AWS innovations to teams around innovative AWS technologies such as machine learning, artificial intelligence, security, etc.; Desired profileYour profile? - You have a Bac +5 type training in the field of 'IT / information system / Digital; - You have at least 5 years of experience in setting up AWS Cloud architectures, with expertise in managing construction projects and migration to the Public Cloud;- You are ideally AWS Architect Professional and TOGAFF certified- You also have knowledge of new automation technologies and scripting languages ​​such as Python, as well as the deployment of AWS as code infrastructure with Terraform;- You have a taste for innovation - You know how to conceptualize and formalize a process; - You have a clear ability to communicate with various people (workshops and presentations), to work in a team and to transmit your knowledge; - You demonstrate analysis, rigor and synthesis, which allows you to link your work and that of your colleagues ensuring development/deployment/run; - You finally have a mastery of English, at least at B2 level.The position is open in Lyon or Nanterre, depending on the candidate recruited, with the possibility of Partial Teleworking. Remuneration: Remuneration, based on a range around 50k to 70k, will be determined according to profile and experience. This salary is part of an overall remuneration package including: - A payment over 13 months - Financial support based on the conditions of employment (travel, etc.); - Profit-sharing, Individual bonus, Preferential rates for electricity and gas; A developed family policy (marriage bonus, birth bonus, extra salary, assistance with children's studies, days off for family events, etc.). This mission is an ideal way to participate in the development of the cloud public within EDF and its French and foreign subsidiaries, to increase your skills and to open yourself up to other departments of the Group in the medium term. So don't hesitate, join us, this position is for you. In the EDF group, welcoming people with disabilities is part of our DNA. Our objective is to open our doors to all skills, all energies and all personalities without exclusion. The position offered is therefore open to everyone. title: Embedded utvecklare - Jönköping
description: In this role, you will be part of a team where you work with the development of embedded systems. Your main focus will be implementing functions in C or C++, programming, debugging and verifying the systems. You will work closely with other engineers, such as electronics developers, testers and application engineers, to create high-quality and reliable solutions. In addition to system development, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to improvements in work methods and processes to further optimize the development flow. The work will take place 100% on site at our customer. Tasks:- Implementation of functions in C or C++ for embedded systems.- Systematization, troubleshooting and verification of the systems at both hardware and software level.- Cooperation with cross-functional teams consisting of electronics developers, testers and application engineers.- Contribute to improvements in working methods and development processes.- Carry out own measurements and simpler troubleshooting at board level using measuring instruments. Requirements profile:- MSc in computer/electronics or an equivalent university engineering degree.- At least 2 years of experience in C/C++ and a strong interest in continuing to develop in this area.- Good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, as documentation and customer contact occur in both languages.- Ability to troubleshoot and test both on hardware and software level.- Experience of make your own measurements and easier troubleshooting with measuring instruments at board level.- Understanding of how software affects hardware requirements and knowledge of Linux and applications in Linux-based systems.- The work takes place 100% on site at the customer. Meriting experiences:- Experience with real-time operating systems.- Knowledge of and experience with GIT and DevOps.- Experience working with IAR Embedded Workbench or Eclipse project tools.- Knowledge of radio communication. Personal qualities:- Great personal commitment and proactivity, you take responsibility for your tasks and look for solutions on your own.- A strong interest in technology and a willingness to constantly learn and develop.- Good pedagogical skills and the ability to convey solutions and knowledge in a clear way.- Open and honest in communication, and respect decisions made by others in the team.- Collaborative and structured , you enjoy working in a team and seek answers within the organization.- Ability to take initiative and responsibility for the tasks you are assigned. Other:- The assignment may require you to undergo a security check and be approved according to current security protection regulations.- For assignments where there are requirements on security classification there may be requirements for specific citizenship.- Travel to subcontractors and customers, both within and outside Sweden's borders, may be included in the assignment.

title: IT-tekniker
description: Company descriptionVattenfall is one of Europe's largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark and Great Britain. There are approximately 21,000 employees within the Vattenfall Group. We have been electrifying industries, delivering energy to homes and transforming life through innovation for over a hundred years. About the role We are looking for you with experience in IT operation and support and who feel confident in your professional role. You have previously worked with troubleshooting clients and also have experience in client development. In addition to your broad competence in client management, we would like you to have specialist knowledge in client security. Your curiosity and your willingness to stay up-to-date mean that you can quickly familiarize yourself with new technology and contribute to improved solutions within the team and the organizationFurther informationIn addition to being able to take part in shaping the smart energy society of the future, we offer you a developing and varied work with many contact surfaces. title: Systemtekniker inom applikation
description: The county boards' IT department is in an exciting development phase where digitalisation, innovative solutions and security and preparedness issues are in focus. Our IT environment is extensive and varied. It includes everything from modern infrastructure to systems that we develop ourselves. Above all, our ideas benefit society as a whole. It gives a very special feeling that is hard to beat. The county councils' activities are very broad and operate in areas that are highly relevant in today's society. Digitization is a strong driving force for the county administrations, where IT often plays a key role in realizing the needs. The county administrations' IT department is national and works for all 21 county administrations in Sweden. Our offer Are you a committed systems engineer who wants to be involved in developing and managing digital solutions that contribute to societal benefit? Do you thrive in an environment characterized by team spirit and the opportunity to develop together? Do you also have experience in Microsoft IIS, certificate management and integrations? Then you can be our new colleague! As a system technician within application, you work with application operation of client-server and web applications. You work with lifecycle management and updates. Furthermore, you set up, troubleshoot, document and maintain the functionality of the applications. You have a close collaboration with the developers regarding requirements that exist for the development of applications. You belong to a team where team spirit and cooperation are key words and you have great opportunities to develop together with us. In this role, you work with challenging and developing assignments together with committed and available colleagues. You get an employer with a focus on a community service to be proud of. Here you have an opportunity to work with technical solutions that affect the whole of society. Our unit, Application Support, is responsible for the development and management of systems, integrations and application platforms. We are building tomorrow's management and development organization where strong teams lead, operate and deliver IT support to the County Boards' tasks. We are always developing our business and you therefore need to be open to the fact that your tasks may also change over time. Location is primarily Gothenburg, Mariestad, Vänersborg, Karlstad or Luleå. Placement in another location may be possible by agreement. We offer flexible work with good opportunities for remote work part of the working time. Qualifications You have: - a university education in the IT field or work-related experience that is considered equivalent - good experience of working with Microsoft IIS, certificate management and integrations - used to working with Windows server (2019/22). We would like you to have: - experience with AD, Networks and Virtualization - experience with PowerShell, Python, Databases or Windows 11 - experience working as a technician in a management organization where you worked in e.g. PM3- the model.Personal characteristics To enjoy and succeed in the role of systems engineer, we are looking for you who are self-motivated in your way of working. You take responsibility for your task, structure your working day yourself and drive your tasks forward. You take initiative, start activities and achieve your goals together with the team. You are good at collaborating and we take it for granted that you contribute to a good working climate. As our colleagues are spread out in many places in Sweden, we work to a very large extent with digital meetings, and the virtual way of working is something you enjoy. to keep you updated. We attach great importance to personal suitability. We believe in equal opportunities for everyone and one of our main missions is to work for diversity and a staff composition that reflects the county's population. Welcome with your application! We would like it to be in Swedish, which is our working language. Good to know You apply for the job via this link: https://lansstyrelsen.varbi.com/se/what:job/jobID:766591/https://lansstyrelsen.varbi. com/se/what:job/jobID:766591/https://www.lansstyrelsen.se/vastra-gotaland/om-oss/jobba-hos-oss/jobba-pa-it-avdelningen.html you can find more information about what it's like to work at the County Boards' IT department. Swedish citizenship may therefore be required for some jobs. Read more about security clearance https://sakerhetspolisen.se/sakerhetsskydd/sakerhetsskyddsatgarder/personalsakerhet.html. The employment may begin with a trial period of 6 months. We have chosen recruitment channels and do not want to be contacted by recruitment companies. Your application becomes a public document when you looking for services with us. Therefore, it is important that you with protected personal data do not register via our recruitment system. Mail your application to the HR unit, Länsstyrelsen Västra Götaland, 403 40 Gothenburg. Do not share any sensitive information in your application, but provide some form of contact information so that we can contact you if you are suitable for the position. If you have questions, contact HR via e-mail hr.vastragotaland@lansstyrelsen.se

title: Expert IT Onsite-Experience (m/w/d)
description: Expert IT Onsite Experience (m/f/d) Committed to research. In action for patients.   With over 120 years of experience and more than 17,000 employees in over 20 countries, Daiichi Sankyo is dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering new standards of care that improve quality of life worldwide.   In Europe we focus on two areas: Our specialty business aims to protect people from cardiovascular disease, the leading cause of death in Europe. We also want to help affected patients enjoy every precious moment of life. In oncology, we strive to be a leading global pharmaceutical innovator with competitive advantages and to develop new therapies for people with cancer.   Our European headquarters are in Munich, Germany, and we have offices in 13 European countries and Canada.   We are now looking for a dedicated IT Onsite Experience Expert (m/f/d) for our location in Pfaffenhofen - Location Pfaffenhofen a.d. Ilm Job details: As an Expert IT Onsite Experience (m/f/d), you are the first point of contact for customers at the ITxBar and you inspire them with first-class service and support. They know how to make a visit to the ITxBar a positive experience for users. You ensure that you get the best out of IT services for your customers and thus derive the greatest possible benefit from them. You also inspire customers with quick and uncomplicated help and you are keen to ensure that your customers know and understand the latest products and services and use them as successfully as possible. They design and operate the ITxBar in such a way that customers are always happy to come back and report positively about their experiences.   Your area of ​​responsibility As an IT Onsite Experience Expert, you will take on a diverse range of tasks. You accompany your customers through all phases of the customer journey in the ITxBar Acceptance of all customer inquiries Immediate solution for "small" tasks (solvable within 5 minutes) Coaching of users with IT problems and handling how-to questions Ensuring that problems are forwarded that cannot be solved directly by the user (e.g. supporting the user when opening a ticket via the chatbot) Carrying out smaller IT training courses Identifying topics and selecting/assigning possible speakers Organizing and carrying out the training courses (10 to 15 minutes) 1x per week Processing participant feedback Additional tasks (when there are no customers at the IT Service Experience Point) Care Chats (contact users one day after the visit and ask if everything is OK) Identification of IT Hot topics (ticket dashboard) and deriving actions for the IT service point (tips & tricks, lunch & learns, etc.), reporting problem candidates Building knowledge and data quality Creating reports and trend analysis Maintaining the proactive Exchange with on-site support and the service desk Prioritization of tasks for the local on-site technician Coordination of the collection or return of IT devices Professional and personal requirements You have specialist knowledge in the IT sector and preferably have a completed degree in business information technology or business administration ( related to IT) or an equivalent completed training.   You have at least 2 years of relevant professional experience in a similar role.   You have a winning personality and a talent for building relationships.   You have a passion for IT support.   You have a quick comprehension and excellent communication skills.   You are ready to take responsibility and act independently.   You have empathy and are able to communicate appropriately with users in difficult situations.   You are interested in innovative, digital topics and can explain new things to customers quickly and understandably.   You speak German and English fluently.   Extroverted, passionate, proactive, optimistic and creative.   You have the special service gene.   Affinity to IT and digitalization.    Why you've come to the right place: Working at Daiichi Sankyo: Working at Daiichi Sankyo is more than just a job - it's your chance to improve the lives of patients. We can only achieve this ambitious goal together. That's why we cultivate a culture of mutual respect and continuous learning, characterized by diversity and inclusion. Here you have the opportunity to develop further, think boldly and contribute your ideas. Do you work proactively and want to advocate for the needs of patients? Then apply now!   Further information can be found at: www.daiichi-sankyo.eu

title: IT Operations Engineer
description: Do you have a passion for cloud technologies and a drive to design and implement innovative cloud solutions? We are seeking an IT Operations Engineer who wants to grow into an Azure specialist to join our dynamic team and help us scale our cloud architecture to new heights.You will play a crucial role in developing and managing our cloud-based infrastructure on Microsoft Azure, ensuring it meets our high standards for efficiency and reliability. This position offers a unique opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects, enhancing your skills in cloud technologies while making a significant impact on our operations.We value team collaboration, and you will work alongside experts in various IT domains. As a leader, we expect you to be present, open to learning new things and have the ability to see the big picture. You have an interest in developing people and value collaboration. To thrive with us, you should be a positive person who sees opportunities and challenges instead of problems. Of course, you stand behind our vision of an active life. So don't wait with your application, apply today! Stadium loves Tech - Come Join the Movement!

Basic requirements: Furthermore, we see that you have an education from a college or university in IT or similar, or equivalent competence acquired in another way. You also have:• Many years of experience working with observability platforms• Many years experience in managing/developing applications on OpenShift or another Kubernetes variant• Several years of experience working with Helm and Kustomize• Good knowledge of building images in Docker/Podman• Experience of GitOps-based way of working• Very good knowledge of both Swedish and English Meritorious (not required) is work experience in:• APM (Application Performance Management) products• Prometheus/OpenTelemetry alternatively Thanos or Mimir• Grafana stackGood to know• The position is located in Sundbyberg ( Stockholm)• Possibility of remote work up to 50% #LI-hybrid• Application deadline is 2024-12-06. title: IT-chef till minPension
description: About the position As IT manager at minPension, you will be part of a small, efficient organization with an important social mission. You are responsible for the newly formed IT unit where you have a central role in leading and developing our IT operations. Your mission is to ensure a stable, secure and future-proof IT environment that supports the business's long-term goals. The role involves both strategic and operational work, where you implement IT strategies, ensure operations and lead technical development projects. You are responsible for our IT suppliers and have personnel responsibility for two employees, report directly to the CEO and are part of minPension's management team. Main tasks Your main tasks: • Develop and implement IT strategies and plans in line with the business's goals. • Responsible for developing IT operations and setting requirements, managing and following up external suppliers.• Ensuring a future-proof IT architecture. • Responsible for the operation and development of technical solutions.• Responsible for ensuring that the IT environment is secure and complies with applicable rules and standards.• Document and manage systems, architecture and processes.• Run projects that streamline the business's technical solutions.Suitable background We are looking for you who have an academic education in IT, computer science or equivalent with several years of experience in being responsible for an IT function. Your experience in and understanding of IT strategy development, supplier management and IT and information security issues is solid. You also have competence in IT architecture, operation and system integration as well as good ability to communicate and present technical solutions at different levels and how these support our goals and strategies.Personal characteristics As a leader, you are used to agile working methods, strategic but at the same time operational, and have the ability to include, engage and inspire your employees. title: Cost Manager / Technology & Datacenter
description: Arcadis is the global leader in sustainable design, engineering and consulting solutions for natural and built assets. We are more than 36,000 people, in more than 70 countries, dedicated to improving the quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. Thanks to the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world's most complex challenges and have greater impact. Your role: Within our Technology & Datacenter department and attached to our team of construction economist, you will be involved in the most visible, complex and demanding construction projects in France, Belgium, Switzerland and North Africa. Our projects are varied and technically demanding. Our clients are mainly international clients with assets or entities in French-speaking countries, and for whom we provide program management, project and cost management, project monitoring and feasibility studies. What will your responsibilities be? Manage projects ensuring appropriate use of resources and budgets to complete work on time; Produce reports and forecasts, monitor budgets, monitor costs and variances in order to manage and control cost variables; Advise the various stakeholders on risk management, compliance and associated behaviors, in order to ensure compliance with Arcadis' risk management and compliance procedures; Analyze and review a range of data and documents using own knowledge together to bring together key themes and trends to provide advice and make recommendations to support cost management and business management decisions ; Manage relationships and collaborate with customers and external stakeholders, to ensure customer satisfaction and create new business opportunities. What are our expectations?  Holder of a Bac + 5 or equivalent in construction economics or any other relevant field in the construction sector, with expertise of at least 7 years in the management of multidisciplinary construction or renovation projects of high value from the point of view of cost and risk management, The ideal candidate must have a solid theoretical and practical knowledge of building, particularly in the part of technical lots, being in charge of the tasks of cost manager while throughout the life cycle of a project. Skills including estimation at all stages of design, procurement and delivery during the execution phase; A professional qualification and/or membership of RICS or UNTEC would be an added advantage. Appreciating the collaborative way of working and used to working in an international environment (fluent English required) Customer-oriented candidate with strong technical curiosity, great capacity for analysis and synthesis Mobile for travel one-off projects with a national scope of action. We can only achieve our objectives if everyone has the opportunity to give the best of themselves. We believe that everyone's contribution is important. That's why we're pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can leverage your unique experience and expertise to chart your career and maximize the impact we can have together. You'll do meaningful work and, whatever whatever your role, you will help find sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Leave your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you. Together we can create a lasting legacy. Join Arcadis. Create a legacy.Our commitment to equality, diversity, inclusion and belonging:We want you to be able to bring your best to work every day, which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and we hold ourselves accountable for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our employees. At Arcadis, we are convinced that by working together, diverse people from different backgrounds make it possible to jointly develop the most innovative ideas. Equality, diversity and inclusion are at the heart of our organization to continue, every day, to improve the quality of life. Well-being at work is the key to the development of each of our employees. We act on six dimensions of equality, diversity and inclusion: age, disability, beliefs, gender, LGBT+ and ethnicity. Our wealth and our strength and at the same time our plurality and our singularity!

Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate cross-functional teams. Experience in leading large, global services providers (or something similar) Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on continuous improvement and innovation. Experience in managing technology budgets and optimizing costs. Knowledge of environmental sustainability practices and their application in IT operations. Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. A Master's degree is preferred.   Language Skills    Ability to effectively communicate in the English language verbally and in writing. Swedish is a plusLocationPreferred location is Malmö or Stockholm, but other global ASSA ABLOY locations are also possible. We would like to see that you have training in the IT administrative area. We also want you to have good knowledge and experience of working in various IT systems and tools. Meritorious is if you have worked in a school or other municipal activity. You have good spoken and written Swedish. In order to fit in and thrive in the assignment, it is important that you are thorough and structured. You take your own initiative and are used to leading yourself in your work. For us, it is also important that you have high social skills, are service-oriented and have a professional attitude towards everyone you meet. Together we all work for the best school for every student! Malmö city's activities are organized in 14 administrations. Our common mission is to create welfare and sustainable social development. title: IT-utbildare inom Applied Script
description: Are you an expert in script programming and IT testing with a strong passion for teaching? Guide students in configuring network devices and managing hands-on exercises with instructions and commands. Deepen participants' understanding of test automation and testing principles. Support participants in carrying out projects where they plan, implement and analyze test results. title: IT Engineer
description: Assignment descriptionJob descriptionIn the role of IT Platform Engineer, you are a key player in revolutionizing the infrastructure behind the next generation of autonomous transport solutions. You will be instrumental in designing, developing, and deploying scalable and reliable on-prem and cloud applications that support the software development teams at the heart of this transformative journey. Your responsibilities span the entire software development lifecycle, from initial requirements gathering to deployment and ongoing maintenance. This involves utilizing your deep expertise in Kubernetes, Cilium, GitLab CI/CD, Crossplane, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to architect secure and efficient systems. Part of your role includes collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure the seamless integration of various technologies, thus enabling the creation of cohesive and robust digital infrastructure. You will evaluate and troubleshoot complex technical issues, ensuring the optimal performance and reliability of our systems. Acting as a technical mentor, you will also support the company's developers by providing them with the necessary knowledge to develop our systems.  Technical skills:- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and IaC.- Experience with successfully designing and implementing software infrastructure solutions. - Problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.  This is our tech stack: - Kubernetes - Terraform and Terragrunt - AWS, IAM, Karpenter, Crossplane, and DynamoDB - Grafana, Tempo, Loki, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry  - ArgoCD and GitLab pipelines - Languages: Python, Bash and Go - BGP and Routing  - Apache Kafka  - Cilium - Redis Meriting: MeriBGP, Routing, Apache Kafka, and scripting in Python and Bash.

title: Automationsingenjör - maskinutveckling - på spännande GPI Systems i Lund
description: Graphic Packaging International is a globally leading packaging company in strong growth. One of the largest manufacturers of cardboard and paper-based packaging for some of the world's most recognized brands as well as a leading manufacturer of innovative and sustainable packaging solutions and high-tech packaging systems. With over 25,000 employees working in more than 130 locations worldwide, we strive to take responsibility for the environment in our industry and in the communities where we operate. In Sweden, there is Graphic Packaging International with production facilities in Halmstad and Lund. Feel free to read more at https://www.graphicpkg.com/Automationsingenjör - machine development - at exciting GPI Systems in Lund Do you love technology and are you good at problem solving? Do you enjoy working in an organization with drive and short decision-making paths? Are you also a technically creative person? Then you should read on! At GPI Systems, you are offered eventful days where you have a key role in the development of high-tech packaging machines in a technically exciting environment. In the role of Automation Engineer, you will participate in all the steps involved in the development of advanced customer-adapted packaging machines. You will be part of an international company that really invests in its employees and offers developing career and training opportunities. The organization is in constant development and you get the chance to grow with great freedom under responsibility. You will be part of a team that, including yourself, consists of three automation engineers. Together with your colleagues, you are part of the technology development team, which also consists of electrical designers and mechanical designers. The group is currently 13 people, with plans to grow, and reports to the Technical Design Manager. Your tasks include: Machine development in the technology development team. Development of machines in various customer projects.Responsible for programming in B&R control systems.Responsible for programming Motion Control.Programming Vision systems. Machine solutions are often customized with a unique packaging format, which means technical challenges in every project, therefore we would like to see approx. 3-5 years of previous work experience with machine systems. You can speak and write fluently in English. It is advantageous if you have knowledge of programming B&R, but not a requirement. Experience with databases, cloud solutions and Industrial Internet of Things applications is advantageous. Your profile: You are a solution-focused person who has a genuine interest in technology. We believe that you are a technically creative person who at the same time has high analytical skills. To succeed in the role, you are probably a person who often finds solutions where others see problems. Since you will be working towards set goals, it is important that you are structured and enjoy working against set schedules. In addition, we believe that you enjoy working in an innovative organization with high competence and great commitment. You balance the drive you have with sensitivity to the environment and a good sense of communication and cooperation. What GPI offersAt GPI, the employees are the biggest asset. In a rapidly growing organization, a variety of exciting challenges and career and training opportunities await. The employees at the center, well-being and well-being are highly prioritized and the employees are therefore offered a generous range of staff benefits: reduced working hours, wellness allowance, access to our gym and masseur at the workplace to use during working hours, pension and insurance advice and discounts on gyms, hotels and entertainment, etc. About the position: The position is a permanent position starting as soon as possible. Placement in Lund. In this recruitment, GPI Systems collaborates with Standby Workteam. We work with ongoing selection and ask you to apply as soon as possible. For more information about the position, please contact Kristian Berglund, Standby Workteam on 0709-605372. Warm welcome with your application!

title: Tullverket söker IT-specialist med inriktning mot säkerhetssystem
description: The Customs Service's IT department is located in Luleå and currently consists of approximately 290 employees. The department provides support for the entire Customs Service and delivers various types of services in various areas to the Customs Service's core operations and other departments. The department delivers IT services to the Customs Agency such as development, operation, management and technical support. About the position As an IT specialist in the area of ​​security, you will work with security systems and their applications to strengthen the Customs Agency's ability in physical security in the form of camera surveillance, passage /access and alarms, etc. You will be part of a cross-functional team consisting of operational specialists both from IT but also from other operations within the Swedish Customs Administration. The area also has close cooperation with our external security suppliers. The area is responsible for further development but also operation, administration and maintenance of the security systems and applications. In your position as an IT specialist, you will be an important piece of the puzzle to drive the area forward. You will, among other things,: • Install, configure and manage rights for the platform based on the developed design. • Continuously plan and implement version and security updates at server and client level. • Maintain, troubleshoot and develop technical solution proposals based on the business needs that come in. • Communicate and collaborate with other IT specialists, external suppliers and users of the systems. of the Swedish Customs Administration.• Experience of work that includes security systems such as, alarms, access systems and/or camera surveillance systems.• General understanding of IT such as, IP networks, Windows server solutions and authorization structures, as well as databases.• Swedish citizenship.• Ability to express yourself well in speech and writing in Swedish. Meritorious:• Competence in security technical systems such as; Pacom Unison, Milestone, RCO or similar.• Safety training through SSF e.g. Certified qualified engineer burglar alarm, Certified qualified engineer CCTV camera surveillance system.Personal characteristics As a person, you are driven, curious and can independently plan and organize your work. You are results-oriented but also have the ability to see the big picture and work towards long-term goals in a quality-conscious way. You are communicative and find it easy to collaborate with others. As a person, you are a team player and enjoy having many collaboration areas both internally and externally, a success factor is to be unprestigious and always look out for the good of the organization. We are looking for you who are driven by having a solution focus and strive for quality in every solution. You attach great importance to quality and details and strive for a well-thought-out and sustainable solution for every problem. For you, the Customs Agency's core value is; Holistic view, Innovative thinking, Taking responsibility, something completely natural. We attach great importance to personal suitability! We offer you An exciting and stimulating job with good development opportunities. The Customs Office is a recognized friendly workplace where we value well-being and culture highly - having fun at work is important to us. The Swedish Customs Service has an important mission and by working with us you contribute to a safe and secure society. We think it is important to have balance in life and therefore our benefits include something we call a flexible workplace. This means that you work both at the office in Luleå and from home based on a level that suits your work, your colleagues and you. Wellness allowance and a wellness hour every week to promote health and well-being. Customs also has an active sports association in Luleå that continuously arranges health-promoting activities. We are careful about our skills and place great emphasis on skill development. There is also the opportunity to develop in different roles within the organization. Customs also offers safe employment conditions as well as good holiday and pension conditions.Other Reference number: TV-2024- 24561. Location: Luleå. The position is a permanent position and individual pay is applied. Start date: By agreement. We place high demands on our employees' security and privacy awareness. Before a decision on employment, you will undergo a drug test and background check. A security check with a register check according to the Security Protection Act is carried out before employment, as the position is placed in a security class. The Customs Service is a total defense authority, and upon employment you may be assigned to the Customs Service. The Customs Service values ​​the qualities that are brought to the operation by having an even distribution of gender and ethnic diversity. For more information and application If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to call recruiting manager Sofia Nilsson , 0920-43 05 38. For questions about the recruitment process, it is fine to call the Swedish Customs Administration's PA support, 060-67 25 85. Trade union representatives are for OFR-P/TULL-KUST, Anders Nilsson, 0920-25 96 31 and for Saco-S, Eva Rutberg, 0920-25 96 39. Your application with an accompanying personal letter and CV/credit list at Swedish, must have been received by the Customs Office by 9 December at the latest. You apply via the electronic application form below. We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies as well as sellers of job advertisements. Customs is a government authority that controls the flow of goods across Sweden's borders. With the vision that only approved goods should cross the border, we prevent illegal goods from entering the country and contribute to a safer society. We simplify trade with other countries and lay the foundation for increased growth and competition on equal terms. The customs office, which was founded in 1636, today has approximately 2,600 employees and is led by Director General of Customs Johan Norrman.

title: IT Operations Specialist
description:
ICAP Executive Search & Selection is one of the premium consultancies and part of ICAP People & Employment Solutions, the largest HR Services Provider in Greece and Cyprus. With more than 50 years of experience, we specialize in assessing and recruiting Senior to Middle Level Executives across all sectors.ICAP Executive Search on behalf of its client, a Bank that started operating as a specialist financier in the Shipping sector and alongside its core market, has extended its activities in Corporate Finance, Trade Finance, Renewable Energy Lending, Commercial Real Estate Lending and Private Banking, is seeking for an IT Operations Specialist to join their team. 
IT Operations Specialist (5785/ITOS/ESS/GR)
The IT Operations Specialist will be responsible for streamlining daily operations and ensuring the smooth functioning of the banking applications. The candidate should be skillful at problem-solving and managing time effectively across various tasks. Strong communication skills are essential for coordinating with team members and vendors.Responsibilities:

Managing day-to-day operations of the IT Banking applications team ensuring the availability and reliability of system
Use a variety of tools (Grafana, Zabbix, E-mail alerts, application specific tools) to monitor the system
Ensure application and service processes and outputs are error free and complete
Set-up and monitor automated jobs in a central scheduler
Create and maintain procedures and protocols (e.g., checklists) for banking applications
Liaise with employees and vendors to ensure seamless operations
Work closely with other bank departments to ensure problem-free user operations
Perform maintenance, and support tasks including patching and release management
Ability to diagnose & address application issues
Assist in software upgrade, migration projects and auditor’s requests as assigned
Ensure continuity of the business processes supported by one or many applications / services
Set-up new users, terminate or modify access rights upon request

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
At least 5 years of T24 or other banking applications working experience
Strong knowledge of RDBMS such as MySQL, MS SQL Server
Proficiency in scripting languages such as SQL, Python, or Shell
Familiarity with ITIL practices and change management processes
Any knowledge of scripting languages, application stacks (such as LAMP), build tools or database monitoring tools will be considered an asset
Proven organizational skills, time management, analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently and take initiatives

title: RESPONSABLE D'APPLICATIONS BUSINESS ANALYST IT H/F
description: Company descriptionDiscover an astonishing professional world!Since 1923, Initial Textile, a major player in industrial laundry, has supported companies wishing to outsource the cleaning of their professional clothing and linens. More than 50,000 customers from industry, hotels and restaurants, and local businesses trust us. Our 25 sites in France manage linen rental/maintenance and delivery with the ambition to provide the best level of service. The only expert in this market to create clothing, our ranges combine comfort, style and safety, adapted to the specificities of each profession. The traceability of our items brings unique added value to our service provision. In 2010, we decided to transform our business, resulting in a totally new generation of cars and technologies, as well as steady growth and record sales. Today, we're expanding our global footprint in Europe, China and the US, and we're on the lookout for new talent. We are constantly pushing our own skills and abilities to drive change in the automobile industry like never before. We are looking for innovative, committed people to join us in this endeavour and create safe, sustainable and connected cars. We believe in the power of people and will challenge and support you to reach your full potential. Within our Computing Infrastructure System (CIS) department, we are at the forefront of this transformation. Our teams are developing the next generation of high-performance in-vehicle computers, known as the "Core System," designed to power a wide range of vehicle applications. These applications span from essential vehicle state functions to advanced active safety features and unsupervised autonomous driving capabilities.We are now looking for a driven and experienced leader with a passion for planning and testing to join us on this ambitious journey.What You'll DoAs a Project Lead/Test Lead within CIS, you will play a pivotal role in driving our strategy and coordinating plans across the organization. Your leadership will ensure that our Core System meets the highest standards of quality, safety, and performance while seamlessly working as intended.You will be responsible for leading the planning and execution of test strategies and initiatives. This includes creating detailed plans that address both software and hardware components, executing comprehensive test cases, and monitoring progress to resolve any issues promptly. In addition, you will contribute to the continuous optimization of test automation processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.This role is your opportunity to make a significant impact on the quality and success of our software releases, shaping the future of our vehicles. You'll work closely with diverse teams, ensuring that our testing efforts are aligned with system designs and development objectives, all while maintaining comprehensive documentation to support the process.Who You AreYou are an experienced professional in software requirements, testing, and test automation, with a passion for influencing outcomes, solving problems, and working collaboratively. You possess strong analytical and organizational skills, which drive your ability to ensure the highest quality in automotive systems.Your educational background includes a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Mechatronics, Electrical and Software Engineering, or a related field. You have over seven years of experience in automotive testing or a similar role, with at least two years in a leadership position.Your expertise includes a deep understanding of automotive engineering, software testing methodologies, and quality assurance processes. You excel in developing and executing test strategies and have hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools. Your leadership abilities enable you to mentor teams effectively and drive quality initiatives, while your communication skills ensure smooth collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.This is your chance to lead and shape the future of testing in a dynamic, collaborative, and forward-thinking environment at Volvo Cars. Join us in driving the evolution of mobility and technology.

You will participate in projects and assignments as an advisory expert with a focus on ensuring that the solutions developed follow our strategy and correspond to set requirements. You come up with solution and design proposals and follow developments and trends in the field and demonstrate new opportunities through technical development. The tasks are varied and you may, among other things: - take part in and drive the development of technical strategy - conduct dialogue with authorities and partners - contribute to a sustainable society through safe and efficient technology solutions. We work, despite geographical spread, very close to each other with specialist competences in various fields. The county boards' IT department is located all over the country. Location is Gothenburg, Karlstad, Vänersborg, Mariestad, Luleå or by agreement. Qualifications You have: - university education in the IT field or equivalent knowledge/experience - broad competence in IT infrastructural products - experience in investigating and suggest technical choices - experience of similar work in the field of architecture. We would like you to have: - experience in the design of robust IT infrastructure - experience from both Linux and Microsoft based environments - experience with various integration and database platforms, preferably MSSQL - habit of reporting solution proposals in architecture forums and knowledge of commonly used architectural tools and modeling languages ​​such as Sparx EA and ArchiMate. Personal qualities We are looking for you who can work independently and have the ability to organize, plan and prioritize your tasks and those of others. Being responsive to the needs of the business feels obvious to you and you are used to collaborating with different professions and groups. In order to enjoy and succeed in the role, we also see that you have good communication skills, are pedagogical and used to presenting technical solutions to various stakeholders. We attach great importance to personal suitability and see it as self-evident that you contribute to a good working climate .Our offerWith us, are you involved in driving digital development forward in the public sector with a focus on security and robustness, with the opportunity to work with IT that affects the whole of society? title: IT Operations Consultant sökes till Nordlo i Ängelholm
description: Are you a person who has extensive experience in working with cloud & infrastructure? We are now looking for an IT Operations Consultant who wants to join our journey. As an IT Operations Consultant with us, you will work with exciting tasks connected to both cloud & infrastructure, both centrally and with our customers. We give you good opportunities to develop in your role and offers exciting and varied tasks within IT. About the serviceWe share experiences between us and our employees have a strong cohesion. You will, among other things, work with our central IT infrastructure and externally with customers, e.g. in projects and case management. Examples of tasks: - Handle assigned cases, both internally and with our customers - Work with assigned areas of responsibility according to documented guidelines - Work with ongoing IT operation, monitoring, maintenance and backup according to documented guidelines - Perform planned system maintenance - Work in selected customer projects based on competence and experience - Ensuring that existing environments are developed and responsible for design and implementation of solutions To thrive in the role, we believe you harWe believe that you, the applicant, are a person who feels secure in their role and has experience in IT operations and has worked in IT environments with both operation and development of IT infrastructure. You find it fun to work with both central IT infrastructure and with our customers and their IT environments. In addition to your knowledge in data center operation, we would like you to also master the following areas - Windows server - Linux - Network - Virtualization - Storage - Data hall - Automation - IT Security - Microsoft 365 - Azure To be successful in the role, it is important that our customers engage you and that you are interested in understanding them and their business. In addition to our competence, we also contribute with good advice that gets our customers to develop their business with the help of IT. You must also master Swedish and English unhindered in both speech and writing. You have a good ability to familiarize yourself with new technology and are good at troubleshooting of varying size and complexity. We would like to see that you who apply are trust-building, both within your own group and towards our customers. You have good cooperation skills and a humble approach to people around you. You enjoy collaborating with others and also have good structure in your own work. About NordloNordlo is one of the Nordics' leading players in cloud and infrastructure. We offer scalable operational solutions, managed services and full outsourcing of IT and digitization services to companies and public organizations. Through close cooperation and with a responsible choice of innovative technology, we help our customers strengthen their competitiveness and drive digitalization forward. title: Facility Leader till Produktionsavdelningen Boden - Luleå
description: The Armed Forces Telecommunications and Information Systems Unit (FMTIS) has overall responsibility for the operation, maintenance and management of all command support systems in the Armed Forces. FMTIS operates continuously in peace, crisis and war, which means that the unit is constantly deployed both nationally and internationally. The unit has more than 1 800 employees spread over roughly 30 locations in the country. Facility Leader to the Production Department Boden - Luleå Main duties As Facility Leader you mainly work to ensure robust operating environments with healthy operating conditions for our Data Halls and IT spaces according to agreements with our clients. The facility function is the contact point within the organization both internally and with external actors. The duties include some travel. You are part of a team that, in addition to issues related to IT spaces, also handles capacity issues related to our operating environments. About the unit and the department DriftE is one of 12 units within FMTIS and is responsible for exercising the function as the Armed Forces' network operator, monitoring and handle problems and incidents as well as perform maintenance and remote remedial measures in the Armed Forces' IT and telecommunications systems. DriftE has approx. 300 employees distributed among 8 departments where the Production Department (ProdAvd) is one of them. The ProdAvd is responsible for production planning and following up the IT/Tele support that is delivered both centrally and locally within the Armed Forces. The production department is also responsible for developing, describing and following up our IT and Tele processes, planning the introduction of major changes and coordinating the introduction of changes in our IT systems. Qualifications• 3-year high school education with a focus on IT or equivalent technical knowledge acquired . We will look at profiles that have a technical/IT background• Experience of IT-related tasks, preferably within a larger operating organization• Experience in the construction industry or the electrical industry• Good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written• B driving license Meritorious • Good knowledge of regulations, building principles and supply systems regarding data centers and IT spaces• Experience of working with data centers and IT spaces• Experience of active monitoring and network infrastructure• Experience of process-oriented working • Experience of working in projects • Education/certification in ITIL Personal qualities • You enjoy providing service and finding solutions to problems • You are driven and used to taking your own initiative • Treating people in a good way is a self-evident for you• You are used to conducting dialogue with various actors• You work in a structured manner and have a good habit of maintaining documentation• You are outgoing, positive and have good cooperation skills• You also have a very good ability to work independently Great importance will be placed on personal suitabilityScope, location, access etc. Permanent employment Access according to agreement The place of work is Boden - LuleåWelcome with your application no later than 2025-01-09 We offer you In the Armed Forces there is a strong value base based on openness, results and responsibility. The business offers great variety and complexity, which means good development opportunities and conditions for internal career mobility. Our employees have a number of different benefits, including:• Competence development based on the needs of the business and your career goals.• Three hours of training a week during working hours and you receive compensation for training clothes and start-up fees.• Good balance between work and leisure with flexible working hours and 28 - 35 vacation days depending on your age.• Wage supplement for parental leave and VAB and the possibility to switch vacation days against extra pension provision. Other The position is civilian, travel in the service occurs to a varying extent throughout the country. The position is a permanent position that begins with a 6-month probationary period for those who are not currently employed within the Armed Forces. Access according to agreement. Place of work: Boden - Luleå If you would like to know more about the position, you are welcome to contact recruiting manager Magnus Svanlund or Dept. Manager Maria Dahlberg Tel: 0589-404 00 (ext.) Union representatives: Union representatives: OFR/S Martin SparrOFR/ O Heikki VidellSACO Agnetha LandquistSEKO Matz FelixAll can be reached through the exchange: 0589-404 00As the employment is placed in a security class, Swedish citizenship is required. A security check with a register check will be carried out before employment in accordance with § 19 of the Security Protection Act. With employment comes national and international work obligations. Applications for this position will only be received via the Swedish Armed Forces' website. Information about the Swedish Armed Forces and the recruiting unit: The Swedish Armed Forces' telecommunications and information systems unit, FMTIS, ensures the Swedish Armed Forces' ability to communicate and lead - around the clock, all year round. The unit has overall responsibility for the Armed Forces' technical management system that supports military operations at sea, on land and in the air - in Sweden and abroad. The association has over 1,800 employees in more than 30 locations around the country. Read more at https://jobb.forsvarsmakten.se/fmtis Employment with us means placement in a security class. Swedish citizenship is usually required.  A security check with a register check will be carried out before employment in accordance with Chapter 3 of the Security Protection Act. With employment comes an obligation to be deployed to war and to serve abroad. The meaning of this varies depending on the type of position. CV and personal letter must be attached to the application for employment. If you continue in the employment process, certified copies of grades and certificates must always be presented. Calls from external recruitment companies and salespeople are avoided.

title: Specialpedagog
description: For the municipality of Strömsund, the goal is simple - everyone should enjoy themselves, have fun at work and have the opportunity to develop and grow with their duties. Our managers have the important task of ensuring that we all feel involved, respected and responsible at work. As a municipality, we are responsible for, among other things, education, care and welfare, social development, the labor market, culture and service services. The jobs we do make the municipality function and it is significant for the residents - and creates meaning in our everyday work. We make a difference for people around the clock, every day of the year. Do you want to be part of our important work? Welcome with your application! The Children's Culture and Education Administration is looking for a special educator for Bredgårdsskolan in Strömsund. Bredgårdsskolan is a school for students from pre-school to year six in Strömsund's conurbation. The school has approximately 200 students and approximately 35 employees. As a special educator at Bredgårdsskolan, you are involved in the entire school's activities. The school has relatively small classes and in each class there is a resource person who works alongside the teacher. The students are distributed in several different school buildings. Leisure centers are located in two of the buildings. We at Bredgårdsskolan work very actively with the value base, it permeates the entire school's work and all staff are out on breaks. JOB DUTIES The special education teacher has overall responsibility for the school's special education work and is part of the school's student health team. Together with the student health team, educators and school management, you create the conditions for a high level of goal achievement. The assignment includes supervising colleagues in the work around groups and students in need of special support. The assignment also includes collaborating with students, guardians and educators as well as being helpful when setting up, for example, extra adaptations and action programs. It also includes carrying out special pedagogic investigations at individual, group and organizational level as well as collaborating with other actors. QUALIFICATIONS We are looking for you who are a trained special pedagogue. It is advantageous if you have previous experience of the assignment and are used to mapping tools and are familiar with and can apply the governing documents. We are looking for you who is cooperative, outgoing and responsible. You are interested in developing yourself and your way of working and dare to think in new directions and have the ability to plan, implement and follow up the business. You have basic computer skills to be able to use the IT tools we have for teaching. OTHER We have made a thoughtful choice of channels for this recruitment. We do not want to be contacted by sellers, please respect this.

title: Lokalvårdare och måltidsbiträde till serviceorganisation centrum
description: Our vision is for Gothenburg to be an internationally leading education and knowledge city. The education administration in Gothenburg conducts activities within municipal high school, adult education, university of applied sciences, adapted high school, komvux as adapted education, study and vocational guidance, mother tongue and school development. In our work, we have a clear student focus that puts knowledge and skills in a context where inner motivation, co-creation and desire to learn are important ingredients. We work based on the equal value and rights of all people. Together we create a work environment where both students and employees are involved and work for each other's success.JOB DUTIES High school area The center consists of Angeredsgymnasiet, Hvitfeldtska high school, IHS and Schillerska high school. The service organization for the Centrum high school area is responsible for premises and property issues, inventory, school meals, premises maintenance and janitorship at Angeredsgymnasiet, Hvitfeldtska and Schillerska high schools. Everyone who works in our schools is important to the development of our students. We work with high expectations and respectful treatment and work actively together to achieve the business's goals. With us, everyone makes a difference at both individual and group level. The students you meet are of high school age and for these young people, with different conditions and dreams for the future, you are important as an adult role model. area with placement at Hvitfeldtska high school and Schillerska high school. Your duties will be divided between these two high schools within walking distance:• Meal assistant (at 10-14) at Hvitfeldtska high school:- Serve food according to current hygiene and safety regulations.- Handle dishes and keep the work station and canteen clean.- Follow given hygiene rules and environmental requirements.• Housekeeper (at 2-6.30 pm) at Schillerska high school:- Cleaning of offices, workrooms, corridors, classrooms, toilets and stairs.- Wash upholstered furniture and use cleaning machines.- Recurring major cleaning, floor care and rough cleaning. - Follow established methods and instructions to ensure quality and contribute to well-kept and pleasant premises. The normal working hours are at 10-14 in the restaurant and 14-18.30 as a janitor, including a 30 min lunch. Times may change during school holidays and study days. QUALIFICATIONS We are looking for you with a high school education and experience of working in both housekeeping and as a meal assistant, preferably with over two years of experience. If you have training in premises maintenance or self-control, it is particularly meritorious, especially if you have both. Experience with cleaning machines and floor care is also meritorious. Good physical condition is a requirement because the work can be heavy. You have good knowledge of Swedish, both spoken and written, and have basic IT skills to use personnel systems and e-mail. It is important that you can work both independently and together with others. The work pace will sometimes be high, which is why it is especially important that you are structured, flexible and problem-solving. You enjoy varied tasks and can quickly learn new things. You show respect and consideration for those you meet in your professional role, and are responsible, service-oriented and positive in your customer service. You are easy to collaborate with others but can also work independently according to schedule and instructions.Welcome with your application!OTHERS For your interview you need to bring your passport/national ID and any proof of residence permit if you have a citizenship outside the EU/EEA. This is because we as an employer need to ensure your identity and ensure that you have the right to work in Sweden. With reference to the laws that regulate register control, the person who is offered this service must show an extract from the tax register before an employment contract can be drawn up. For the positions where there are requirements for education If you continue in the recruitment process, you will have to submit documents that prove your education, e.g. identification or diploma. You can also attach them directly to your application.

title: Linux Systemadministratör
description: Are you an experienced System Administrator with deep knowledge of Linux? Do you want to take the next step in your career and work with advanced IT solutions in operations and infrastructure? We are looking for a Linux System Administrator with a few years of experience who has a passion for creating stable and efficient environments and who wants to play a key role in IT operations. Here you get to work with the latest technology and contribute to ensuring high-performance systems and seamless infrastructure. About the role As a Linux System Administrator, you will play an important role in an operations team and work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure stability and high availability in systems. You will be responsible for maintaining and optimizing Linux platforms as well as handling various aspects of system administration and security. Your expertise will be critical to maintaining an efficient and secure IT environment, working proactively to identify and resolve any technical challenges. It is a role where you get the opportunity to work with the latest technology and contribute to the development of a stable and future-proof infrastructure. We believe that you are a driven system administrator who has: Several years of experience with Linux (for example Red Hat, CentOS, Ubuntu) with an understanding of the system's ecosystem Operation and maintenance of Linux servers, including security configurations and network administration Knowledge of automation and scripting, preferably experience with tools such as Ansible, Puppet or similar Experience of working in complex IT environments with high demands on availability and security Experience with container tools such as Docker and Kubernetes to manage and scale applications Experience with web-based and server-oriented services, such as Apache, Nginx and database systems (SQL and noSQL) Merit experience Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation of deploy processes Knowledge of security solutions within IT infrastructure and experience with advanced security configurations Experience working with HPC (High-Performance Computing) and GPU/vGPU management Experience with Linux VDI solutions and management of virtualized Linux environments What we offer With us you get stable employment with: Competitive conditions and fixed monthly salary Opportunities to develop and specialize in your area of ​​expertise An open and pleasant work culture with regular activities for team spirit and community About usWe are a leading player in operations and IT infrastructure and works with market-leading companies in a number of different industries. Here you get the opportunity to develop within advanced projects and work with the latest technology. We are keen that our employees enjoy themselves and offer a safe and developing environment where you receive support in your career development. Application Does this sound like your next step? Selection is ongoing, so please submit your application as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you!Pauline.Ryott@nexergroup.com Department Infrastructure Role IT Infrastructure Locations Stockholm, Linköping Competence Data/IT

title: Data Center IT Technician
description: About NebiusLaunched in November 2023, the Nebius platform provides high-end infrastructure and tools for training, fine-tuning and inference. Based in Europe with a global footprint we aspire to become the leading AI cloud for AI practitioners around the world.Nebius is built around the talents of around 400 highly skilled engineers with a proven track record in developing sophisticated cloud and ML solutions and designing cutting-edge hardware. This allows all the layers of the Nebius cloud - from hardware to UI - to be built in-house, differentiating Nebius from the majority of specialized clouds. As a result, Nebius customers get a true hyperscaler-cloud experience tailored for AI practitioners.As an NVIDIA preferred cloud service provider, Nebius offers the latest NVIDIA GPUs including H100, L40S, with H200 and Blackwell chips coming soon.Nebius owns a data center in Finland, built from the ground up by the company's R&D team. We are expanding our infrastructure and plan to add new colocation data centers in Europe and North America already this year, and to build several greenfield DCs in the near future.Our Finnish data center is home to ISEG, the most powerful commercially available supercomputer in Europe and the 19th most powerful globally (Top 500 list, June 2024). It also epitomizes our commitment to sustainability, with energy efficiency levels significantly above the global average and an innovative system that recovers waste heat to warm 2,000 residential buildings in the nearby town of Mäntsälä.Nebius is headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with R&D and commercial hubs across North America, Europe and Israel.The roleWe are looking for a Data Center IT Technician. You will work in the data center with the modern H200 GPU cloud cluster, support IT infrastructure, and solve the IT hardware issues.You're welcome to work in our colocation in Paris, France.Your responsibilities will include:Solving issues with IT hardware and supporting IT infrastructure in the data center.Collaborating with related departments and external contractors.Installing, upgrading, and dismantling hardware by request.Commutating fiber optic and patch cords.Planning and processing regular IT tasks for IT infrastructure.Processing RMA following manuals.Writing manuals for working with hardware.We expect you to have:Practical experience in solving server hardware issues.Knowledge of the principles of the data center, server, and network equipment.Basic skills working with the Linux operating system and command line.Experience of working with server IT hardware, enterprise-based network switches, and fiber optics.Experience with MS Excel (pivot tables, formulas, lists, graphs).Strong written and spoken fluency in English.It will be an added bonus if you have:Driving license B categoryProject planning skillsWe're growing and expanding our products every day. If you're up to the challenge and are excited about AI and ML as much as we are, join us!

Manage Active Directory to ensure secure and efficient user access to all relevant systems
Collaboration with external service providers to provide and continuously develop virtual desktop and cloud services
