At least five years of experience in IT operations with a focus on virtualization and digital workplace solutions (Citrix/VDI)
In-depth knowledge of Windows server and client operating systems, Citrix, VDI, cloud technologies and infrastructure management (VMware, NetApp)
Strong analytical and problem-oriented way of thinking to solve complex IT challenges in the areas of virtualization and IT security
A high level of self-motivation and the ability to translate business requirements into efficient and scalable technical solutions
Very good German (C1) and good English (B1) skills for collaboration in international projects and cross-location communication

What awaits you:

Collaboration in a dynamic team that is committed to innovative and sustainable solutions
Attractive and fair remuneration in accordance with the collective agreement

Flexibility also in the place of work - combination of mobile working and on-site days for optimal work-life balance
Opportunities for individual professional development through training, coaching, mentoring and targeted talent development 
Cooperations with various fitness studios with discounted membership
BusinessBike bicycle leasing to promote health and well-being and contribute to environmental protection
Subsidized company events and meetings to strengthen team spirit and celebrate shared successes
Subsidized canteen food with varied, thematic offerings
Subsidy for company pension provision for a secure future
Ergonomically designed workplaces
Childcare subsidy

title: Utvecklare av processautomationer
description: With digitization, we develop our operations with the help of digital technology. With robotic process automation (RPA), many administrative processes are already managed for several financial process flows. We see great opportunities in increasing the degree of automation in finance, but also in our core activities of healthcare, public transport, regional development and education. We are therefore looking for reinforcements for our RPA team. Your tasks include:- Mapping and analyzing existing and future process flows- Designing the automated solution- Developing the solution in one of our RPA platforms- Documenting automated solutions- Collaborating with system administration to manage changing conditions Your work is carried out both individually and together with others in the team. We strive to create a balance in the team's competence to handle the mentioned tasks. Each team member can focus on certain parts, but has the competence to carry out all parts if necessary. Your location is in our pleasant premises in central Kalmar. About you We are looking for you who have: - Academic education in the field or other education and professional experience that is considered equivalent - Experience of working with the development of process flows - Experience of programming in general, meritorious if there is experience of development in any RPA platform and uses of API To thrive in this role, you are happy to work together with other people. You are clear, articulate and committed, listen and adapt to the situation. You are happy to start activities, plan, organize and prioritize these in an effective way until the results of the activity are achieved. Your future workplace Work with IT that benefits society! The IT administration exists to facilitate the various operational areas so that they can put patients and residents in focus. This places extremely high demands on the IT we deliver. Our mission is to be responsible for an accessible and secure IT environment and to, in close collaboration with Region Kalmar County, all businesses drive and support work with the possibilities of digitization. In the IT administration, there are approximately 180 employees in the towns of Kalmar, Oskarshamn and Västervik. Region Kalmar County is responsible for health and medical care, dental care, community colleges, culture, public transport and regional development. We are over 7,000 employees who all work together for a healthier, safer and richer life for the county's residents. With us you get many benefits and one of Sweden's best collective agreements. We meet people at all stages of life and have meaningful and developing work - every day. Region Kalmar County offers all employees 100% employment. If you work part-time but wish to work full-time, an extension of service can be offered at another workplace. We want you to attach your CV, personal letter and educational certificates relevant to the position to your application. In order to ensure the quality of the recruitment process in Region Kalmar län, we want you to apply for the position in our recruitment system and not via e-mail or in paper format. We are happy to receive calls from you who are interested in the job, but we refuse you who sell advertisements and recruitment services.

title: Verksamhetsutvecklare
description: Do you want to work tactically and strategically with business-driven IT solutions? We are looking for you who have worked in the role of business developer or similar and want to work in the IT organization at Uppsala University!At university-wide IT at Uppsala University, technology and innovation meet old traditions and our task is to contribute to creating a functioning interaction between IT and business .Right now, Uppsala University is carrying out a change project where we are developing IT operations in order to be able to offer high-quality and coordinated IT support for world-leading research and education. You will have the chance to develop in an organization that makes use of competence, initiative and cooperation skills. Together, we will create a future-oriented IT organization that develops world-class services and working methods and offers in-demand IT support close to the business. We are looking for you who want to be involved in the development of the university's IT operations. The department for university-wide IT works with strategic IT issues and is at the same time a service organization for joint services where the mission includes infrastructure, administration, service and support. The new department has around 200 employees divided into six units. Job duties We are looking for Business Developers for the Staff Unit and the newly formed Development Office group who will work with client support for Uppsala University's entire business. The role includes partly representing university-wide IT (UIT) in the business with knowledge and support about our services, partly representing the business's needs and orders within UIT. as well as to represent UIT in various contexts at department level and equivalent, as well as within the department. You will act as a catalyst for digital business development by developing and implementing overall strategies to strengthen the organization's competitiveness. Act as an advisor to both operations and IT, with the goal of creating synergies and promoting effective collaborations. Support in the introduction of common working methods, governance forms and processes for digital mobility. The role also includes challenging and inspiring managers and employees, as well as creating conditions for identifying and implementing important development initiatives. You will work to ensure the delivery that UIT stands for the business. Your areas of responsibility will include customer support, requirements capture, change management and investigative work to varying extents. You will work to establish and maintain relationships with different parts of the business, both within the department and within the entire university. Qualification requirements - At least 5 years of work experience as a business developer, senior project manager, change manager or similar role that the employer deems equivalent. - You have a relevant academic degree or equivalent competence that the employer deems equivalent, combined with several years of relevant work experience for the position. - Very good ability to document and communicate your work in an educational way in speech and writing, both in Swedish and English. - Very good ability to see and work for the whole, being able to understand and account for complex contexts and processes. - Accustomed to working with concretizing ideas and needs analysis as well as monitoring the environment. Great importance will be placed on personal suitability, such as that you are committed, non-prestige and service-oriented. Furthermore, we see that you have great initiative, independence and the ability to solve problems. You can establish and maintain good relationships with both demanders and executors within the university's organization. You want to work in an industry in constant change and with varying tasks, both independently and in a group.Desirable/otherwise meritorious- Experience of similar tasks in an authority or other public activity. - Work with mapping and design of business processes. - Experience in service pricing and utility calculation. - Knowledge of Uppsala University and a well-developed network with one or more departments/equivalent. If the employment The employment is permanent, probationary employment can be applied. Extent is 100%. Access by agreement. Location: Uppsala Information about the employment is provided by: head of unit/bitr IT director Christer B Andersson christer.b.andersson@uu.se, 018-4716167 or group manager Victoria Ström, victoria.strom@uu.se, 018-471 7742Welcome with your application no later than 8 January 2025, UFV-PA 2024/4284.Uppsala university is a broad research university with a strong international position. The ultimate goal is to conduct education and research of the highest quality and relevance to make a difference in society. Our most important asset is all 7,600 employees and 53,000 students whose curiosity and commitment make Uppsala University one of the country's most exciting workplaces. Read more about our benefits and what it's like to work at Uppsala University https://uu.se/om -uu/work-at-us/The employment may be subject to a security check. In the event of a security clearance, a prerequisite for employment is that the applicant is approved. We refrain from offers of recruitment and advertising assistance. The application is received in Uppsala University's recruitment system.

title: IT-Specialist till IT-Verksamheten, Region Västernorrland
description: We are a force that binds together, holds together and develops the county. Within Region Västernorrland, we are all part of something bigger. The area of ​​IT, MT and digitization is tasked with developing and managing overall and joint processes for the area. It is also responsible for services within these parts. The area coordinates the region's digitization work. Our operations are mainly located in Sundsvall, Härnösand, Örnsköldsvik and Sollefteå. The mission of the IT operations is to deliver IT services of high quality and security to the region's operations. Deliveries take place through projects, management and support for a complex and life-giving business. IT also works to a large extent as a client organization because the region's IT operations are managed by an external supplier. Now we are looking for an IT specialist for our team! The position is a full-time permanent position with entry on 2025-02-01 or by agreement. IT-Specialist to the IT Operations, Region VästernorrlandJobs You are part of the management of the object Quality and financial management, which is tasked with creating conditions for Region Västernorrland's system within, among other things, Analysis and follow-up, HR, E-Commerce and Finance. In your assignment, you work with management and development of the object's system. Your duties will include: Support to the business in matters within your area of ​​responsibility Ensure the functionality and usability of the services Identify development needs for increased business benefit Coordination responsibility for development teams Testing and troubleshooting of systems and software Documentation of processes and the functions of the systems Other information Qualifications We are looking for you who have a post-secondary education in the IT area, alternatively equivalent knowledge from work experience Has experience in requirement capture, analysis, design, test and implementation Has experience in work in complex operations, for example within a region, municipality or private sector Have good knowledge of spoken and written Swedish Have good knowledge of spoken and written English It is advantageous if you have knowledge of ITIL or the management model PM3 Have experience with Microsoft Server, SQL databases or working in DevOps Has experience in team management/coordination To be successful in the role, we believe you have these personal qualities Self-motivated Collaborative Ability Quality conscious Initiative taking Region Västernorrland With approx. With 7,000 employees and over 200 professions, we at Region Västernorrland are responsible for several of the activities that are most important for the residents' opportunity to participate in society. Here, your knowledge and commitment make a difference in everything from healthcare to culture, environment and sustainability. Become part of a team where everyone is needed. Together for a growing Västernorrland. The region has been working for many years to create the conditions to contribute to healthy employees. That you feel well and enjoy yourself is important to us. One of our many benefits is that we offer SEK 5,000 per year in wellness allowance. Read more about Region Västernorrland, our benefits and what it's like to work with us: Region Västernorrland - To work in Region Västernorrland (rvn.se). Within Region Västernorrland, a number of positions are placed in a security class and security checks may therefore take place. We have made our media for recruitment and therefore avoid contact with advertising sellers or other sellers of recruitment services. Selection and interviews take place continuously. A warm welcome with your application!

title: Säkerhetsspecialist fokus informationssäkerhet till SFAB
description: The energy industry is in an exciting phase of development and safety is becoming increasingly important. We at SFAB are at the forefront when it comes to safety work, but of course we need to continue to develop in the area. During 2025, we plan to further develop our information security work. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to safe and climate-smart energy use and at the same time ensure that our operations are conducted according to the highest safety standards. Are you committed, development-oriented and passionate about information security? Do you want to have an important role and at the same time contribute to a socially important function in the region? Then we have the perfect opportunity for you! The position as a security specialist with a focus on information security is a parental leave temporary position of one year. Duties As a security specialist with a focus on information security, you have the main responsibility for SFAB's information security, with responsibility for running and developing the work in information security in accordance with current and future legislation in the security area such as NIS2 and the CER Directive. Our goal is to achieve all the requirements of the upcoming cyber security law. The role also includes assisting the security manager with other tasks, for example in physical security as well as risk, crisis, preparedness and continuity. You are an important support to the Head of Security as well as the CEO and department heads in these areas. You report to the CEO. Main tasks:* Carry out activities to ensure that the company's operations meet the requirements of the upcoming cyber security law. * Develop internal routines within information security work. * Act as a support function to the CEO and department heads in information security matters. * Own and follow up agreements with external suppliers in information security. * Collaborate with relevant external parties such as the municipality and other security managers in the energy sector. Experience and qualifications We are looking for you who have:* A university education, post-secondary education or other relevant education or experience in the information security area that the employer deems equivalent. * At least three years of work experience in the security area where you have been involved in driving and creating work methods in the information security area. * Good knowledge of spoken and written Swedish It is advantageous to have training in NIS, NIS2 or ISO 27001.Personal characteristics As a person, you are development-oriented and driven. You are structured with good analytical skills and have a clear focus on results. You have the ability to work independently and can work strategically even under time pressure and to explain and motivate others. That you are communicative, responsive, non-prestige, and good at creating and developing relationships is a prerequisite for success in the role. An ongoing improvement work demands a genuine interest in supporting others, you should therefore have good teaching skills and find it easy to cooperate with others. You also have good organizational skills and can set wise priorities. We offer Here you get an exciting job in an organization where environment and development are the focus. We offer several different benefits, such as a gym at the workplace, reduced working hours, an attractive wellness allowance, lunch allowance, health insurance as well as a favorable pension agreement and an active staff club. We know that our employees are the key to success and satisfied customers, therefore we work consciously to be a stimulating and responsible workplace, where skill development and balance in life are important parts. Diversity and equality help us to develop and we work actively with health and wellness. Feel free to read more at https://rekrytering.sfab.se/Ytterligare information The position refers to a parental leave substitute in just over a year from February 10, 2025 with location Norsborg. The position may be exposed to security classified information according to the Security Protection Act, which means that a security screening interview will be conducted. Contact and application: In this recruitment, SFAB is collaborating with Jefferson Wells. For questions, contact recruitment consultant Katarina Thomasson on 070-231 28 05 alt katarina.thomasson@jeffersonwells.se. SFABSFAB's operations play a significant role in the circular economy. We contribute to safe and climate-smart energy use, sustainable social development while taking responsibility for our environment. We supply energy to two-thirds of those who live and work in the municipalities of Huddinge, Botkyrka and Salem - one of Sweden's most expansive regions in terms of new construction of both homes and workplaces. As the region expands, energy solutions are needed that can meet the growing need for heating and cooling, and then we are the natural and local energy partner that creates resource-smart solutions that are good for the customer, us and the climate. We are proud of our district heating and cooling. SFAB has an annual turnover of approximately SEK 800 million and a total energy delivery of approximately 1 TWh. In addition to district heating, the product range also includes energy consulting services, service and cooling. The company is certified according to the environmental standard ISO 14001 and the management system for employees ISO 45001.

title: IT Chef till Brottsförebyggande Rådet
description: Now, on behalf of the client, we are looking for an experienced IT manager for a rewarding assignment starting immediately and approximately 10 months. About the assignment The assignment is a 100% consulting assignment via Bemannia starting as soon as possible and until October 2025. You will be placed at the unit's office in Stockholm. The authority that you will work for has an impact on reducing crime and increasing safety in society. They do this by gathering facts and spreading knowledge about crime, crime fighting and crime prevention work. The authority is under the Ministry of Justice and is responsible for Sweden's criminal statistics. Your duties As an IT manager at the authority, you will be responsible for running, developing and leading the IT unit's work with a particular focus on the digitization work that has been started at the authority with the aim of strengthening the authority's ability to carry out their mission in an optimal way. The following tasks will be included: To drive, develop and coordinate the authority's IT operations, by being a strategic and operational IT support for the entire authority. This includes IT workplace, internal IT support, IT security as well as management and development of the authority's statistical system and internal support systems. Responsibility for outsourced servers and for IT coordination with authorities within the judicial system. To have a close collaboration with all stakeholders in the business, integrate the improvement work and create a joint structure to prioritize and create consensus. To constantly improve and develop processes, routines and working methods by creating a climate of improvement, a learning organization. To ensure that the work is based on and complies with applicable laws, agreements and regulations. Finance, personnel and work environment responsibility for the entire unit. To have close cooperation with other law enforcement authorities. Your qualifications Relevant education in the IT field, or other education deemed equivalent. Several years of experience in the role of IT manager or equivalent. Experience of having been a manager of IT operations that includes infrastructure. Experience of having been a manager of IT operations that includes system development. Experience from the public sector. Experience of purchasing goods and services in the public sector. Experience of carrying out change work at both strategic and operational level. 2 reference assignments must be able to be specified where you have had similar assignments within the last 7 years. Meritorious Experience of having been a manager of IT operations that includes both infrastructure and system development. Experience of having been an IT manager in the public sector. What we offer you As a consultant at Bemannia, we offer you close contact with your consultant manager and an opportunity for more assignments through us. With us, you can develop in educational workplaces and feel that your skills will be useful. About the application Apply for the position by clicking on apply below. Feel free to upload your CV in word format and in Swedish. Selection and interviews take place continuously and the position may be filled before the application deadline, 18/12. We do not accept applications via email, but if you have specific questions about the position, these will be answered by the person in charge recruiter, Anna Radhe, anna.radhe@bemannia.se. For general questions about your application or our recruitment process, you can reach us during office hours at 0708934700Bemannia is a public and Swedish-owned staffing and recruitment company that provides competent and qualified personnel through letting, recruitment and personnel contracting within Organization & Leadership, PR & Information, Marketing & Sales, Finance, Law, HR & Personnel, Real Estate & Technology, IT & Data and Office & Administration. Bemannia has framework agreements with most of Sweden's authorities and Sweden's municipalities, their administrations and companies. Bemannia is a member of Kompetensföretagen and is an authorized Staffing company and Recruitment company and has a collective agreement with Unionen, Akademikerna, SEKO as well as LO and Hotel and Restaurant Employees' Union. Bemannia is certified according to SS-EN ISO 9001:2015, Management system for quality, SS-EN ISO 14001:2015, Environmental management system - requirements and guidance, SS-ISO 45001:2018, Management system for work environment and SS-ISO/IEC 27001:2013 Management system for information security The management of the company has been active in the industry for 40 year.Professional area Managers and business leaders Role Interim manager Locations Stockholm Remote work Remote work

title: IT Specialist - Identitets- och Behörighetshantering
description: About EdgeEdge of Talent is a recruitment and consulting agency specializing in matching talent with the right companies. We are dedicated to creating successful collaborations by understanding the needs of both our clients and candidates. With a strong presence in the market and a wide network of contacts, we ensure that our candidates get the best possible start in their new role. Your role As an IT Specialist, you will be a central part of an agile team that drives the development of solutions for identity - and authorization management. Together with product owners, IT architects, developers and administrators, you will work in a department that is under rapid development and has a high priority to ensure control, traceability and security in our systems. Your responsibilities Operational work with systems such as Omada Identity and Ubisecure , including release planning, upgrades and operations. Collaborate with operational providers for configuration, integration and implementation of solutions according to security requirements. Implement and customize IAM solutions to meet business needs, including integration with systems such as Active Directory and HR applications. Develop custom scripts and API integrations to ensure seamless communication between systems. Train users in the functionality of the systems and ensure correct documentation of processes and technical solutions. Support technical teams with troubleshooting and improvements to existing solutions. Qualifications At least 4 years of experience in information security and authorization management. Documented experience in implementing and managing IAM solutions, preferably Omada and Ubisecure (or equivalent systems). Experience working in agile teams and using tools such as Jira and Confluence. Understanding of security policies and regulatory requirements within IAM. Accustomed to documenting technical solutions. Merit experience Integration between IAM solutions and other systems, for example Active Directory or LDAP. Scripting (eg PowerShell, Python) and using APIs to customize and integrate systems. Previous work on the client side with operating suppliers. Experience with IAM concepts such as SSO, MFA, user provisioning and deprovisioning. Schedule and scope The assignment starts on February 1, 2025 and initially runs until February 1, 2026, with the possibility of extension according to 1+1+1 years. The scope is full-time, 40 hours per week. Location: Stockholm, with the possibility of remote work Scope: Full-time, 40 hours per week Apply now to become part of an exciting project with great development opportunities!

title: IT-specialist - IGA / IAM
description: Description of the assignment We are looking for an IT Specialist, for assignments at our client, with experience in identity and authorization management and control. The consultant will be part of an agile team that includes key roles such as product owners, IT architects and specialists, IT developers and administrators. Today, our client has an ongoing IGA project where they are working on connecting systems to their centralized IAM solution for identities and permissions and for secure login. It must be continued with the goal of connecting the majority of our IT systems to the centralized solution. We are looking for someone who can roll up the sleeves. Who is not afraid to push things forward positively by booking meetings, writing documents and making explanatory pictures. Our client places a high value on collaboration. This is one of the IT department's fastest growing and most core product and capability areas, where the organization hopes to move quickly to ensure full control, traceability and ownership within the area. These projects will be central to the current roadmap and associated IT projects that extend from 2024-2029. The roadmap includes projects and initiatives related to both establishment, upgrading, introduction, migration and transformation. Overall content of the duties Work operationally with administration-related handling of Omada and UbiSecure, for example planning and implementing release and upgrades together with the operation supplier. Technical support to the Service Desk for IGA related questions. Responsible from TG's side for the entire implementation process for Omada Identity and Ubisecure solutions, from planning to operation. Place relevant orders with our operating supplier.  Be a discussion partner with the operating supplier for the details of our orders, e.g. Configurations, how the solutions are to be integrated in accordance with TF's security and user management requirements.  Implement user and access management systems to ensure proper management of user permissions and security. Work closely with other technical teams (eg network, security and application development) to ensure integration meets all technical requirements. Customize the Omada and Ubisecure solutions to suit specific business needs and requirements. Work with custom scripts and APIs to enable seamless integrations between the IAM solutions and other systems, such as Active Directory, HR systems and business applications. Test and validate the solutions to ensure they function correctly and meet company security standards. Ensure that all implementations of Omada and Ubisecure solutions comply with company security policies and external regulations, Provide technical support to users and administrators to manage identities, authentication and permissions in Omada and Ubisecure. Train internal users in functions of the IGA solutions. Create and maintain documentation for system configurations, integration flows, and operational policies. Report on progress and identified issues during the implementation phase to the project manager and management. Participate in upgrades and patch management of Omada and Ubisecure solutions to ensure systems are always current and secure. Propose and implement improvements to optimize system performance and security over time. Requirements: At least 4 years of work experience in information security and permissions. At least 4 years of work experience implementing and managing identity and access management solutions, preferably with experience from Omada and Ubisecure. But other similar system experiences also go well. At least 2 years of experience in setting requirements for design and development in an Omada Identity environment or similar, e.g. sailpoint. The consultant must have documented experience from at least two assignments within regulatory controlled operations, e.g. authorities, public operations. Worked at least 4 years in an agile team with e.g. Jira, Confluence, standup, kanban board, co-creation in documents, etc. Experience in documenting technical solutions from at least 2 assignments in the authorization and identity area At least two assignments where the consultant has acquired an understanding of security policies and compliance requirements related to IAM Meritorious: At least two years of experience working with integrations between Omada, Ubisecure and other systems , for example Active Directory, LDAP, or other user management systems. At least two years of practical work with scripting (e.g. PowerShell, Python) and the use of APIs to adapt and integrate the solutions At least 2 assignments worked with an operation supplier on the client side At least 2 years of experience with IAM concepts and technologies such as Single Sign -On (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), user provisioning and de-provisioning, etc. Terms Scope This is a full-time temporary position during the period 01-Feb-2025 - 01-Feb-2026, at NXT Interim Stockholm AB. We apply a collective agreement. Our client provides a computer, mobile phone and e-service card, as well as a workplace at their office in Kungsholmen Stockholm. The assignment currently enables both remote work, but the project tries as much as possible to meet physically in the office most days of the week. It may be relevant to support other projects during the period. We do not accept sub-consultants in this assignment. Does this sound like a interesting role? Apply today and we'll tell you more. We need an application, including CV, in Swedish, which matches our client's wishes. Selection and interviews take place continuously, so don't wait with your application as the tender period is short.NXT Interim and NXT Rekrytering is a niche and innovative company that operates in the consulting and recruitment industry. We are active in HR, IT, Finance, Sales and Marketing and have 20 years of experience in the industry. We offer our consultants, among other things, health insurance, remote workplaces and several other benefits that brighten their everyday life. Keywords: Omada, Ubisecure, IAM, IGA

title: Engagerade specialister som vill leda industriell digital transformation
description: Rejlers is one of the Nordic region's leading technology consultants and a recognized strong competence company with a long tradition of running complex projects in industry, energy, infrastructure, real estate and communication and security. An enormous digital transformation is underway at our industrial and energy customers where large investments in the smart of the future activities are done. We work with some of Sweden's largest industrial and energy customers and help them design the digital infrastructure and operations of the future. The demand for our services is high. Rejlers is in the middle of a major investment in industrial digital transformation with units in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Karlstad, Umeå, Luleå and Piteå, which work at the forefront of the industry's digital transformation. Our goal is clear, become Sweden's "Leading House for Digital Transformation" and deliver consulting and advisory services in digital transformation, digital capabilities and digital systems and we are looking for you with experience and commitment that can help us shape this journey.  ABOUT THE JOBWe are now looking for several specialists in industrial IT/OT, people who understand and have experience working with factory-based systems such as SCADA, MES/MOM, QMS, IIoT or OT security. You will work as a consultant and guide our customers and lead projects in industrial digitization and thus help our customers in their efficiency work and digital transformation. We are looking for you with experience and a strategic mindset that can support our customers' organizations in choosing overall solutions, system selection, procurement support, system integrations and implementations, and/or commissioning. The role gives you the opportunity to develop both technically and from an operational perspective. At Rejlers, we have set our sights on becoming the industry's most learning organization - Home of the learning minds, you will work together with other knowledgeable experts who are happy to share their knowledge and experience. Together with your colleagues, you contribute to building a strong offer for our customers who are in industries such as paper and pulp, mining, steel and manufacturing industry and energy companies. WHO ARE YOU? You appreciate the role of consultant and are comfortable handling varied challenges and environments. You have developed the ability to understand and adapt to the customer's needs and challenges and you can communicate with people in different positions - regardless of technical knowledge level. We also hope that you, just as we should, think it is important that we have fun together, even at work!Regarding your technical skills, you should basically have a relevant university education with you, for example an education in computer science, technical physics, automation or electrical engineering. You should also have 5-10 years of work experience from similar roles, preferably where you have been involved in industrial projects in one or more of the following areas:• IT architecture • System architecture • Project management • System development • OT security • Databases Experience from heavy industry is a advantage, but we also value competence from other technical sectors. We see experience from the consulting industry as meritorious. Experience of system architecture within OT and integration of IT/OT systems for industrial or energy companies is also highly meritorious. For this role, you need to be fluent in Swedish and English in speech and writing. WHAT YOU GET You and your team get to be involved from the start and build a new offer within Rejlers within Smart Industry! Here you get the opportunity to actively contribute to the development of our new offers and working methods. As if that wasn't enough, you also get a leader who values ​​participation, forward-thinking and innovation. We take care of our employees and are committed to creating as good a working climate as possible so that you as an employee can thrive and develop. For us, learning and our employees are most important. Rejlers is a platform for continuous learning, development and growth. Our services are important building blocks for achieving a sustainable society. Since the company was founded in 1942, Rejler's success has been built on the ability to constantly learn new things. Our vision "Home of the learning minds" guides us to continuous learning, development and growth. With our cutting-edge expertise, we help companies, authorities and other organizations meet tomorrow's societal challenges. With the help of value-driven digitization, we create a sustainable future through knowledge. We distinguish ourselves by being "the 'small big' company" in our industry - we are big enough to win the most interesting assignments, while at the same time we have a family company culture with short decision-making paths. During the Christmas holidays, it may take a little longer before you get feedback from us. We appreciate your patience and hope you have a great weekend!*** As a qualitative step in our recruitment processes, a background check will be conducted on the final candidate. Some roles also require other control, such as e.g. security check, before assignments with certain clients - if it is relevant for the service you applied for, you will receive more information about it at a later stage. Further information can also be found here: Processing of personal data | Rejlers We review applications on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Department Industry Locations Piteå, Luleå , Umeå , Karlstad , Gothenburg , Stockholm Application deadline 19 January 2025

title: Domain Manager Security & Platform at Cibes Lift Group
description: Are you driven by the challenge of building secure, future-ready IT platforms? Do you want to shape the future of IT security while working hands-on with cutting-edge technologies? If you're excited about innovation, teamwork, and making a real impact, this is your opportunity to shine.As Domain Manager Security & Platform, you'll play a central role in our global IT evolution. Leading the way in IT security and platform management, you'll design strategies, implement solutions, and guide your team to success. Whether it's optimizing our use of Microsoft 365, Azure, and Entra, or driving transformational change, your work will ensure a secure, modern digital workplace.What You'll DoLead and Innovate: Drive the development of our cloud strategy and IT security processes, ensuring our platforms are cutting-edge and resilient.Solve and Protect: Keep our systems running smoothly, proactively minimizing risks and incidents.Guide and Collaborate: Support and inspire your team of three co- workers as you work closely with colleagues across the organization. title: IT-infrastruktur generalist
description: Job description Do you have extensive experience in IT infrastructure and see yourself as a generalist? Have you worked with most things in the Microsoft world and want to continue broadening your skills? If so, this could be the role for you! In the role of IT infrastructure generalist, you will work in a global team, together with two colleagues on site in Jönköping, and support the business with matters related to networks, cloud services, virtualization and backups, etc. You will work with monitoring, maintenance, support and optimization of the IT environment. If you have questions about the position, please contact Carolina, carolina.klockaregullesjo@randstad.se. For Randstad, it is important that all skills in the labor market are utilized. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. Randstad Digital is your career partner in IT and digital transformation. As a consultant with us, you will receive a competitive salary, benefits and collectively agreed terms. Your consultant manager, who is always close at hand, ensures that you get varied and developing assignments at different companies, in different industries. As your career partner, we apply our talent-centric strategy that puts your development in focus, which helps you achieve your full potential and opens up new exciting career opportunities.ResponsibilitiesIn this role, together with your team, you will be responsible for the physical and cloud-based IT - the environment is stable, safe and efficient. You will monitor and maintain systems combined with support and development. You will have a lot of contact with various stakeholders internally but also with suppliers and partners externally. Qualifications We are looking for you who have worked as, for example, a system administrator, IT infrastructure technician or similar for at least five years, and you are welcome to have experience from the manufacturing industry. You also need to have a post-secondary education or equivalent work experience. Technically, you need to have a broad competence in IT infrastructure, especially in networks, server operation, workstations, storage and backups. This position requires fluent Swedish and English in speech and writing. We attaches great importance to personal suitability and important for this role is good collaboration skills as the role has many contact points but also a commitment and a well-developed sense of service.  We would like to see that you are curious and have a desire to continue developing.ExperienceSystem administrationNetwork administrationServer administrationSql Database AdministrationCisco FirewallsAbout the companyRandstadAt Randstad, we know that all people have a place in the labor market. title: IT-chef | Tiohundra
description: Tiohundra is looking for an IT manager who will play a central role in driving and developing our IT strategy to support our vision of delivering quality healthcare. In this strategic position, you will collaborate with management to lead digitization projects, develop the IT team and ensure that our IT solutions are both efficient and innovative. We offer a stimulating work environment, management training programs and good development opportunities within a culture characterized by participation and respect. If you have experience in driving change work and a great interest in the growing possibilities of technology, we look forward to your application! in line with our vision - Quality of life and health through integrated care and care. title: Product Owner
description: Are you an expert in the field of purchasing? Or are you familiar with the supply chain field? My end client is looking for his future P.O specialized in Purchasing/Purchase The company is made up of 3000 people, spread between France and abroad. You are joining an IT department of around 100 employees.  CREATION OF POST ON CDI International company, located in ST PRIEST. Pauline Duverger, consultant at FED IT, dedicated to the recruitment of IT professions in the Rhône Alpes sector, is looking for a Product Owner for her client as part of the creation of a permanent position. International company, located near Bron .The company is made up of 2,500 people, spread between France and abroad. You are joining an IT department of around 80 people. Accessible by transport of course, but we suggest you come by car for a easier access! Your role: This involves participating in a global company project concerning the evolution of the ERP (evolution of the technical stack, UX and functional modules). You will work internally with other P.Os in your team, development teams, internal ERP teams (CI, Qualif, Deploy), Digital teams, CDPs, end users and business teams. title: IT Manufacturing Transversal Senior Engineer
description: Presentation of Soitec and context of the positionSoitec is a company listed on the SBF 120 index of the Paris Stock Exchange which operates upstream of the microelectronics value chain. Our innovative semiconductor materials are essential to the operation of smartphones and the deployment of 5G. They also offer numerous opportunities for connected automobiles, electric and autonomous vehicles and embedded intelligence in connected objects. This position gives us an incredible responsibility, which inspires us every day: making possible the massive adoption of technological innovations while considerably limiting their environmental impact, in a logic of responsible innovation and sustainable development.The context of the position:A Soitec, the CIM team is in charge of all manufacturing applications: Manufacturing Execution System, Automation, Process control &; tuning, CMMS, automatic transport, and is involved in all 4.0 initiatives (3D printing, connected glasses, mobility, scheduling/dispatching, cobots, AGV, etc.). What is the job? You will join our dynamic IT CIM team (" Computer Integrated Manufacturing") to support our roadmap towards "more CIM & 4.0". Under the responsibility of the Corporate CIM Manager, and as a senior IT Manufacturing Transversal engineer you will be required to: Participate and lead various cross-functional projects such as new automations, R2R/RMS projects, implementation of Scheduler/Dispatcher, new workshop applications, etc. Collect, analyze business needs, prepare functional/technical specifications Manage sub -contractors or develop the solutions themselves, test/deploy the solutions, write operating files, etc. Liaise with the various IT teams (CIM, Data, Infrastructure, technical department) to ensure that projects progress well and meet our norms and standards. Work with the CIM team in Singapore (information sharing, co-design, project transfers between sites) to ensure that we are moving in the same direction management and that we achieve the same functional coverage. This position will meet your project if you are...Engineer • 3rd cycle or Master in computer science / mathematics, you benefit from significant experience in the semiconductor industry. You are autonomous on automation technologies SECS/GEM, .Net, Angular, SQL, Git, CI/CDIf you know or master Promis, Siview, VB6, AMHS, R2R E3 (Amat), SPACE (Camline), RMS (Camline) , FDC (PDF Solutions), that's a plus! You have a strong appetite for functionality and understanding the company's business. You are recognized for your good interpersonal skills which allows you to maintain and develop your network. In addition, your strong culture of quality will allow you to easily understand the constraints of our environment and the specificities of the semiconductor industry. You are autonomous and know how to step back and adapt on complex and very varied subjects. You are pragmatic and you have a sense of innovation. You have a good level of English (oral/written) allowing you to communicate effectively with the group's interfaces (France, Singapore) and external service providers. If in the life you leave nothing to chance, that autonomy is one of your assets, and that you enjoy working flexibly in a changing environment and with many people around you, you are made for this position! Join us!Additional information:This position is identified as a “sensitive position” with regard to European customs legislation applicable to Soitec SA as part of its certification as an “Authorized Economic Operator” and requiring access to the Z.R.R.

The coming years will be marked by exciting initiatives to develop both business and guest experience, with a particular focus on our newly opened Liseberg Grand Curiosa Hotel and the water world Oceana, which will be inaugurated in 2026. The IT department plays a key role in this journey. With 18 employees divided into the areas of Strategy , Development, Operation and Support, the department is responsible for supporting the entire business - from networks and local data centers to cloud-based services in Azure and MS365 environments. Here we deliver a mix of self-developed and procured IT solutions to both guests and employees. Your role as an IT technician We are looking for you who are passionate about IT and want to be part of our operations team. You will play a central role in managing and further developing our device management for future needs. With us, you get to work in a unique environment with a strong focus on both local operation and cloud operation in Azure. Your tasks include: Management of computers, phones, hand scanners, cash registers and other devices in the business. Use of tools such as Microsoft Intune and Configuration Manager for to deploy and secure devices. Troubleshooting, application management and security work in Microsoft environments. Proactive work to improve operations and prevent problems. You will work closely with your colleagues and at the same time have the opportunity to influence solutions and development in digital workplace. Who are you? You probably have a university education in IT and a few years of experience in IT support or service desk, where you have developed a strong interest in device management. Now you want to take the next step and work more specifically in this area. To succeed in the role, we see that you have: At least 3 years of experience in IT and 1 year in device management in Microsoft Intune. Good knowledge of identity and security management in Microsoft platforms .A structured and careful way of working and the ability to work both independently and in a team. We also value a positive attitude, initiative and interest in new technology. What we offer you With us you get to work at the forefront of technology in an environment characterized by joy and development. We offer: Great opportunity to influence and design IT solutions. Close cooperation with the business, where your work makes a difference to both guests and colleagues. Varied tasks that develop your knowledge and skills. Terms and application The position is a full-time permanent position with access according to agreement . Welcome to become part of Liseberg and contribute to creating joy for both guests and colleagues!

title: IT-tekniker Luleå

title: Tullverket söker IT-specialist med inriktning mot säkerhetssystem
description: The Customs Service's IT department is located in Luleå and currently consists of approximately 290 employees. The department provides support for the entire Customs Service and delivers various types of services in various areas to the Customs Service's core operations and other departments. The department delivers IT services to the Customs Agency such as development, operation, management and technical support. About the position As an IT specialist in the area of ​​security, you will work with security systems and their applications to strengthen the Customs Agency's ability in physical security in the form of camera surveillance, passage /access and alarms etc. You will be part of a cross-functional team consisting of operational specialists both from IT but also from other operations within the Swedish Customs Administration. The area also has close cooperation with our external security suppliers. The area is responsible for further development but also operation, administration and maintenance of the security systems and applications. In your position as an IT specialist, you will be an important piece of the puzzle to drive the area forward. You will, among other things,: • Install, configure and manage rights for the platform based on the developed design. • Continuously plan and implement version and security updates at server and client level. • Maintain, troubleshoot and develop technical solution proposals based on the business needs that come in. • Communicate and collaborate with other IT specialists, external suppliers and users of the systems. We are looking for you who have: • Post-secondary education or other education/experience deemed equivalent of the Swedish Customs Service.• Experience of work that includes security systems such as, alarms, access systems and/or camera surveillance systems.• General understanding of IT such as, IP networks, Windows server solutions and authorization structures, as well as databases.• Swedish citizenship.• Ability to express yourself well in speech and writing in Swedish. Meritorious:• Competence in security technical systems such as; Pacom Unison, Milestone, RCO or similar.• Safety training through SSF e.g. Certified authorized engineer burglar alarm, Certified authorized engineer CCTV camera surveillance system.Personal characteristics As a person, you are driven, curious and can independently plan and organize your work. You are results-oriented but also have the ability to see the big picture and work towards long-term goals in a quality-conscious way. You are communicative and find it easy to collaborate with others. As a person, you are a team player and enjoy having many collaboration areas both internally and externally, a success factor is to be unprestigious and always look out for the good of the organization. We are looking for you who are driven by having a solution focus and strive for quality in every solution. You attach great importance to quality and details and strive for a well-thought-out and sustainable solution for every problem. For you, the Customs Agency's core value is; Holistic view, Innovative thinking, Taking responsibility, something completely natural. We attach great importance to personal suitability! We offer you An exciting and stimulating job with good development opportunities. The Customs Office is a recognized friendly workplace where we value well-being and culture highly - having fun at work is important to us. The Swedish Customs Service has an important mission and by working with us you contribute to a safe and secure society. We think it is important to have balance in life and therefore our benefits include something we call a flexible workplace. This means that you work both at the office in Luleå and from home based on a level that suits your work, your colleagues and you. Wellness allowance and a wellness hour every week to promote health and well-being. Customs also has an active sports association in Luleå that continuously arranges health-promoting activities. We are careful about our skills and place great emphasis on skill development. There is also the opportunity to develop in different roles within the organization. Customs also offers safe employment conditions as well as good holiday and pension conditions.Other Reference number: TV-2024-27786.Location: Luleå.The employment is permanent employment and individual salary setting is applied.Starting date: By agreement.We place high demands on our employees' security and privacy awareness. Before a decision on employment, you will undergo a drug test and background check. A security check with a register check according to the Security Protection Act is carried out before employment, as the position is placed in a security class. The Customs Service is a total defense authority, and upon employment you may be assigned to the Customs Service. The Customs Service values ​​the qualities that are brought to the operation by having an even distribution of gender and ethnic diversity. For more information and application If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to call recruiting manager Sofia Nilsson , 0920-43 05 38. For questions about the recruitment process, it is fine to call the Swedish Customs Administration's PA support, 060-67 25 85. Trade union representatives are for OFR-P/TULL-KUST, Anders Nilsson, 0920-25 96 31 and for Saco-S, Eva Rutberg, 0920-25 96 39. Your application with an accompanying personal letter and CV/credit list at Swedish, must have been received by the Customs Office by 27 January at the latest. You apply via the electronic application form below. We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies as well as sellers of job advertisements. Customs is a government authority that controls the flow of goods across Sweden's borders. With the vision that only approved goods should cross the border, we prevent illegal goods from entering the country and contribute to a safer society. We simplify trade with other countries and lay the foundation for increased growth and competition on equal terms. The customs office, which was founded in 1636, today has approximately 2,600 employees and is led by Director General of Customs Johan Norrman.

title: IT-specialist
description: Boverket is the national authority for planning, construction and housing. We want to contribute to a sustainable society with good housing in viable environments. The housing authority has its head office located in Karlskrona, with a smaller office in Malmö. Today, around 230 people work in the authority, including architects, civil engineers, economists, lawyers, communicators, planners and social scientists. JOB DUTIES The Housing Agency's IT unit has overall responsibility for all IT at the Housing Agency and is responsible for both user support, system management, development and daily operation of IT systems. The housing authority works actively with digitization and automation of processes. We are now strengthening our IT management organization with a new IT specialist/technical system manager. In the role of IT specialist, you will be part of one or more administrative teams led by our IT administrative managers and who work closely with the Housing Agency's business operations. Together, we ensure that the systems deliver operational benefits. We work according to the system management model PM3. As an IT specialist, you work with the IT systems from a technical perspective with various tasks linked to development and management. Examples of tasks:• carry out requirements work,• review and evaluate solution proposals and estimates,• plan and carry out various types of tests,• work with technical support in collaboration with other functions, • manage application operation both in terms of client and server side, • work with configuration, • create and maintain technical documentation, • work with IT/information security issues. QUALIFICATIONSWe are looking for you who has current experience in technical system management. You have good knowledge in several of the following areas: application development, application operation, database technology (e.g. SQL server) and IT security. It is desirable that you have basic knowledge in IT infrastructure. Basically, you have a relevant university education in the IT field, or equivalent experience that the Housing Authority deems equivalent. You are technically interested and have good communication and collaboration skills. You enjoy working both independently and in a group. You express yourself clearly and pedagogically in Swedish in speech and writing.  It is important that you are structured, quality-conscious and able to work with several tasks in parallel. As a person, you are driven, educational and proactive and you work with a holistic view based on the needs and requirements of the business. We attach great importance to these abilities. The Housing Authority is an authority that ultimately works on behalf of the citizens. We are looking for you who have respect and humility for the role of a state employee and a great interest in social issues! OTHER The public authority is subject to the Publicity Principle, which means that the information you share with us in your application documents may be requested as a public document. Therefore, remember not to give out more personal information than you consider appropriate in this recruitment. During the Christmas-New Year period, the Housing Agency has a lower staffing. Recruiting manager and union contacts can be reached most easily until after January 6 for questions. To ensure quality and streamline the recruitment work, we use an electronic application form in collaboration with Visma Recruit. Upon application, your personal data will be handled in accordance with the GDPR. Through your application, you consent to the processing. Your application is a public document in accordance with the principle of public disclosure, and will be saved by the authority for 2 years after recruitment has ended (in accordance with the National Archives' regulations on thinning). If you have a protected identity, references or the like that you yourself consider inappropriate to disclose, contact the responsible recruiter. Prior to the recruitment work, the Housing Authority has taken a position on recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore strictly avoid contact with media sellers, recruitment sites and the like.

title: Teknikansvarig bana till SYSTRA
description: Do you want to be part of shaping the infrastructure of the future together with us at SYSTRA? With us, you get the opportunity to develop in a dynamic environment where you get the opportunity to work in exciting infrastructure assignments. A dedicated team works with us, supporting each other, sharing experiences and having fun along the way! Do you want to join? Apply for the position today! This is what some of our employees say: "The family feeling and atmosphere that prevails within the company helps to create fun assignments and pleasant working days. Here we socialize and support each other, regardless of which group we belong to and every day brings exciting experiences. I have enjoyed myself very much since day one!" /Martin S"The community in the office combined with being a key person in projects makes you feel good at SYSTRA. Freedom under responsibility is the key word." - Michael OAs a technical manager with us, you have an important role in our assignments where you have the overall responsibility for the technology area Bana. Your main task is to see the technology area as a whole and coordinate the technology area so that the requirements regarding finances, quality and goals are met in the assignment according to the contract and ABK. You work actively to help, follow up, share information and decisions within the planning group and that the group develops and works together towards common goals. Among other things, you will be responsible for: Acting as a technical manager or leading designer in the technical area of ​​track. Ensuring that the customer's and other stakeholders' goals and requirements are met in the product to be delivered. Creating system documents, construction documents and request documents. Carrying out investigations. start-up and ongoing follow-up during the assignment. Collaborate with other technical areas and report to the assignment leader. Responsible for planning and delivery as agreed and within the framework of the established budget and schedule. Carry out reviews and ensure compliance with applicable regulations and requirements. If necessary and competent, assist in the tender and start-up phase. Ensure that technical solutions are buildable and meet legislation, requirements and customer wishes. Act as a mentor for junior resources and contribute to the company's development in the technical area of ​​track. Contribute to continuous experience feedback. You will work together with our wonderful team in Uppsala, Stockholm or Norrköping as well as collaborate digitally with our other colleagues from our other locations in Sweden but also internationally. About you We are looking for someone who has a great interest in technology and keeps you updated in the field. You are responsible, analytical and structured in your way of working, handling all details carefully and ensuring that nothing is overlooked. Your good collaboration skills mean that you easily find solutions together with others, while at the same time you have the ability to plan and drive the work forward independently. Furthermore, you communicate clearly and effectively with both customers and other stakeholders and have a good ability to conduct technical discussions, handle clarifications of requirements and share information. We also see that you have a flexible approach and enjoy navigating through changing conditions. Qualifications University degree or equivalent YH training, such as railway projectionist or have acquired knowledge in other ways. At least 3 years of experience in designing the track of a railway project. Have a very good knowledge of all current components in the technical area of ​​the track. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English in both speech and writing. Meritorious Good knowledge of ABK 09, AB 04 and ABT 06Knowledge of tender documents in FU : UF, UK, AMA, MER and UBE Experience with multidisciplinary projects What can we offer you? SYSTRA develops innovative solutions for sustainable travel. You become part of an organization that takes responsibility for the environment, projects and employees. We offer services in transport, civil engineering and infrastructure. In Sweden, we have roughly 700 employees. Our working climate is characterized by forward thinking, competence and cooperation. Both experienced and junior employees work with us and we are keen on a high degree of exchange of knowledge and experience both within and between technical areas. We strive to be a workplace where all employees thrive and feel good - where you can maintain a good balance between work and leisure. Please read more about us on our website, which is linked in the advertisement. Location and other information We offer permanent employment starting according to agreement. You will be based in one of our offices in Stockholm (we have offices in both the south and the north), Uppsala, Västerås or Norrköping, but we also offer the flexibility to work remotely a few days a week. Business travel may occur. Contact details Saga Hävermark, Group Manager SYSTRA shavermark@systra.comJoachim Ahnsjö, Regional Manager SYSTRA jahnsjo@systra.comJohanna Ekman, Recruitment Partner SYSTRA jekman@systra.com Application Selection may take place on an ongoing basis so we welcome your application today. SYSTRA- confidence moves the world Before the recruitment work, SYSTRA has carefully considered recruitment channels and marketing. We therefore strictly avoid contact with media sellers, recruitment sites or the like.

title: Systemutvecklare
description: The correctional service is growing - we are building new, rebuilding and building more and are now looking for more employees. Our most important goal is to reduce recidivism - to break the vicious cycle. If we succeed in that, society will be safer and more secure for everyone. We are the authority responsible for institutions, probation, detention and client transport. Do you want to be involved and contribute to a safer society? Our IT department is carrying out a major investment with a focus on a digital Correctional Service. Together, we work to create conditions and solutions that make a difference in our business. The IT department is undergoing strong growth. With us, you get good opportunities to grow and develop skills according to your conditions and areas of interest. We are looking for you who have a great interest in IT, skills that can enrich our digitization journey and who want to be part of and make a difference in society within your particular profession.JOB DUTIES Are you a driven system developer who wants to be part of and streamline the development of the Correctional Service's own developed applications? The Platform and Mobility group plays a central role in our digitization strategy and we are now looking for a new colleague who wants to contribute to our development and modernization. Right now, we are looking for System Developers who can join and contribute to our development in the platform area that enables our self-developed applications to function as well as possible. Within the Correctional Service's IT operations, we work with self-developed solutions in a Microsoft environment and the most common programming languages ​​are .NET and C# . We work hard to support our business through automation, a well-functioning development environment and monitoring to be able to work proactively. We contribute to our colleagues outside the country being able to take care of convicted clients as well as possible and achieve our vision Better. You will be part of a team with knowledgeable and pleasant employees where collaboration is highly in focus. The constant learning is an important part as well as implementing small frequent deliveries often to create as much value to our users as quickly as possible. This also includes contributing with support and problem solving where much is gained by being curious about how the applications and systems work. We offer a chance to gain practical experience and grow in your professional field. A stimulating work environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous learning. You get the opportunity to influence your own development and career path. You will have a supportive manager who works for you to thrive and develop with us, as well as flexible working hours and the possibility of remote work 3 days a week. QUALIFICATIONS We are looking for you who work well with other people, are calm, attentive and courteous in your treatment. You have the ability to see the big picture and take the larger perspective into account. Furthermore, you work well with complex questions and can analyze and break down problems to arrive at a solution. You are also a person who can make quick decisions and act based on them. For us, it is important that you share the Prison Service's basic values ​​of a humane view of people, respect for the individual and belief in the human will and ability to develop. You are also aware of and understand how background, culture and group affiliation affect yourself and others. Furthermore, with your approach, you are expected to contribute to everyone being treated equally. We attach great importance to personal suitability. We are looking for you who have: • Academic degree in a relevant IT field • Several years of experience in system development • Several years of experience working in .NET and C# • Good knowledge of .NET and C# • Ability to express yourself fluent in spoken and written Swedish It is advantageous if you have:• Experience with Azure Devops• Experience with GitOTHERWe place high demands on our employees' security and privacy awareness. title: IT-utvecklare för e-arkiv
description: The municipality of Ulricehamn is in a continued growth phase. In just a few years, we have gone from small to bigger, without losing our identity. In close cooperation with employees and residents, we do the most possible social good. For the municipality as an employer, this means a unique breadth of assignments with good opportunities for development for you as an employee. In Ulricehamn municipality we make a difference in people's everyday lives every day, all year round.Ulricehamn municipality works goal-oriented through Vision 2040 together towards the future.- Join us and create it with us!Ulricehamn municipality is the host municipality for a joint e-archive for the municipalities Bollebygd, Herrljunga , Mark, Svenljunga, Tranemo, Vårgårda and Ulricehamn. Currently, the work is run in project form via the Borås region - Sjuhärad municipal association and will be transferred to administration in connection with the turn of the year 2025/2026. From a purely organizational point of view, the position is directly subordinate to the head of office. The office unit is one of the municipal management staff's support functions. Here we work with administrative support for the political leadership, law, archival issues, elections, investigations and here is also the Notary Public. JOB DUTIES As an IT developer for our joint e-archive in Sjuhärad, you together with the e-archivist form the core of our collaboration around e -archives. This exciting position means that your tasks will change depending on the phase you and we are in.  During the project phase, you will be part of the working group for the project, which means that you will be very involved in the development and influence future work. By e-archive we mean the people, the technology and the organization together. An important task is to support the collaborating municipalities in creating deliveries for the e-archive. As an IT developer of e-archives, you will read out information from various systems, programs and services, if necessary process the information and then read it into our e-archive system. In other cases, it may involve setting up API connections between systems and our e-archive system. You are part of a central working group that drives the work with the e-archive, carries out relevant investigations and coordinates prioritization and connection plans which the steering group then determines. The project working group also manages the submissions to the e-archive. Strategically, the central working group cooperates with the local organizations in the cooperative municipalities in order to obtain a basis for prioritization and connection plans. There is the possibility of working remotely for some time. QUALIFICATIONS You have university education as a system developer, other education or practical experience in programming that is considered equivalent. Knowledge of scripts such as xml and python is advantageous. You have experience of working with information management in public activities and preferably from practical work with e-archives and delivery projects. You are meticulous, have a good ability to work independently, take initiative and be the driving force in development issues when it is of the greatest importance. You also need to be able to understand the law in the area, monitor the environment and be able to put legislation and other people's experiences into our context. title: Epic owner
description: Do you want to help shape the digital society of the future? Now you have the chance to step on board our journey towards an innovative and digitized future, where we not only strengthen IT services and operations for our own systems but also for other government agencies. We are building a new dynamic unit full of competence and drive, and we want you to join in and make a difference. Are you ready to be a part of something big? Join us and make society possible! You will also report on the progress of the initiatives and identify and communicate any obstacles in relevant portfolio level forums. Within the role, you are expected to ensure that stakeholders who are involved or affected by the development work and cooperation for the whole when implementing the initiative. With us, you get a flexible and stimulating work environment where we encourage your own initiatives and ideas. With great freedom and responsibility, you combine a meaningful working day with a balance between work and leisure. You have knowledgeable colleagues with whom you exchange experiences and you can develop both breadth and depth with us. In addition, you will be part of a workplace where we have fun together and at the same time create real social benefit. Your location is Sundbyberg. About you To do a good job and feel comfortable with us at the Tax Agency, you need to be responsive, think new and take responsibility. In the work, good judgment and an understanding of legal certainty and safety are important. You must also live up to our https://skatteverket.se/medarbetarpolicy. In this job, you must:- have good cooperation skills, be helpful and have a good attitude - be relationship-building where you create and maintain good relationships - be initiative-taking and drive issues forward - be development and solution-oriented where you are responsible for delivering the best possible results, even in situations where the requirements are unclear or unspoken - have good ability to communicate clearly in Swedish and English in speech and writing. You must also have: - relevant university education of 180 credits/120p, alternatively multi-year, current and relevant work experience - current and relevant experience of leading and supporting agile teams - current and relevant experience of leading work where the interaction between IT systems, people and organizations has been a key factor - multi-year, current and relevant work experience of project management/epic management within complex IT organizations, such as authority or other large organization. title: IT-säkerhetsarkitekt till Riksbanken

Requirements• You have several years of practical experience working with IT security architecture and requirements in the IT security area.• Good knowledge of cloud solutions and their security functions• Good knowledge of IAM (Identity Access Management)• Good knowledge of Swedish and English in speech and writing Meritorious• Experience of relevant frameworks such as ISO27000 and NIST CSF• Work in the public sector, operation and management as well as competence in IT infrastructure, networks and operating system (Unix and Windows).• Experience in risk management, continuity planning and requirements towards suppliers.• Relevant certification in the field, e.g. CISSP, CCSP, CCSK etc. Working at the Riksbank The Riksbank is an authority under the Riksdag that ensures that money retains its value over time and that payments can be made safely and efficiently.
