title: Assistant/Associate Professor in AI for networks - CDI
description: Who are we?Télécom Paris, a school of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of the top 5 French general engineering schools.The guiding mission of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment.We are looking for a teacher-researcher in AI for networks, the position is to be filled in the Computer Science and Networks department (INFRES). Nowadays, we are witnessing a growing demand for participation in research projects related to AI for and in the networks of the future, as well as significant interest in teaching subjects that connect not only data science for the development of new models but also the environments hosting these models and their constraints. The market for next-generation networks (5G, 6G, and beyond) is expected to exceed 90 billion dollars within the next decade, with the embedded AI sector identified as the dominant trend of this revolution.In this future landscape, MLOps engineers with dual expertise in AI and networking will be essential. AI is becoming pervasive and distributed at all levels of the network hierarchy. In this context, AI applied to networks (AI4NET ) and deployed within them (NET4AI ) is emerging as a distinct field, separate from classical AI. This field focuses not only on optimizing and managing communication infrastructures but also on addressing new challenges, such as operating on a different and near real-time temporal scale and dealing with the scarcity of computational resources (network devices are not computing servers).In this context, some operations considered "basic" in traditional AI/ML approaches, such as using large language models (LLMs), are nearly impossible to implement in real systems with limited resources and strict performance constraints. A typical use case is the optimization of cloud/network equipment, driven by the increasing complexity of these systems.Such operations (management plane) could potentially be facilitated by configuration or log analysis via an LLM, but in a high-speed environment, this remains unrealistic given the number of parameters involved (throughput constraints) on the one hand, and the reaction time requirements (latency constraints) on the other. Offloading part of the processing directly into devices (in-network ) is an option, but its efficiency is limited by the constraints on available resources.It is therefore crucial (i) to investigate the limits of AI-driven computation within converged cloud/network systems, and (ii) to propose practical solutions for these environments that can guarantee a satisfactory QoS while respecting energy and/or performance constraints. These challenges require a broad expertise, ranging from optimizing AI algorithms for network environments, distributed systems, as well as sustainability and energy resource management. The ideal candidate profile will be able to address these topics, ranging from data acquisition and analysis in networks (wired, wireless, or virtualized) to optimizing network performance while considering the energy/performance trade-off. Topics such as network architecture design and the implementation of data acquisition systems are also central to the profileYour main tasks will be to:- Participate in the design and implementation of courses in the field of AI applied to Networks- Conduct research in your scientific field- Participate in and contribute to the scientific activities of the Group in which you works.- Participate in the development of partnerships, collaborations and contractual relations in the field of AI applied to Networks.Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devez avoir un doctorat et avoir des compétences générales et complète en informatique. La/le candidat.e doit posséder une solide compréhension des réseaux, y compris des systèmes physiques et virtualisés (dans des environnements en nuage). Une profonde maîtrise des concepts architecturaux des réseaux (tels que les réseaux TCP/IP) et du cloud est demandée. En outre, le candidat doit avoir de solides connaissance des concepts de l'intelligence artificielle, y compris les flux de travail de l'IA, l'acquisition de données et le développement de modèles. Une expérience de l'intégration de l'IA dans les systèmes de réseaux et de l'optimisation des performances des réseaux par des méthodes d'IA est considérée comme un avantage.Vous devez également Maîtriser des concepts de workflow IA (collecte de données, entraînement, validation, déploiement) dans des environnements de systèmes en réseaux (cloud, edge, core devices, etc.), avoir des connaissances des grandes infrastructures numériques et leurs outils de gestion/déploiement (systèmes cloudifiés, CI/CD, DevOps), maitriser la programmation en C, C++ et/ou Python. La maîtrise de l'anglais est obligatoire.Est un plus si vous avez une :- Expérience post-doctorale ou internationale dans un laboratoire académique ou industriel appréciée- Expérience dans l'enseignement- Expérience en pipeline DevOps et MLOps- Connaissances sur les problématiques d'efficacité énergétique dans les systèmes à hautes performances.- Expérience en ce qui concerne les mesures réseaux et l'évaluation des performances (génération de trafic, tests des équipements, etc.).Si vous êtes passionné(e) par la l'intelligence artificielle nous serions ravis de recevoir votre candidature.Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers, navette mutualisée en partance de la Porte d'Orléans). Vous bénéficierez de :49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT)Flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service)Télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possibleRemboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75%Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne...Associations du personnel au niveau de l'école et du ministèreA savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privéModalités de candidature : Pour candidater envoyez les éléments suivants :- un CV détaillé- une lettre de motivation- les rapports de thèse et de soutenance- les perspectives d'enseignement (activités menées, méthodes pédagogiques utilisées, projet d'enseignement de formation initiale et formation continue (max 4 pages)- les perspectives de recherche (synthèse des principaux axes de recherche, projet de recherche) (max 4 pages)- une copie des 3 principales publications- les noms et adresses mail de deux personnalités qualifiées pouvant donner un avis éclairé sur la candidatureSélection : Le processus de sélection se déroule en 5 étapes :- Elimination des dossiers qui n'ont pas les qualifications requises- Echange avec l'équipe d'accueil pour établir une liste des candidats présélectionnés- Entretien préalable avec les Ressources Humaines- Audition par la commission de recrutement et classement des candidats retenus - Entretien final avec le directeur de Télécom ParisInformations complémentaires :Fin candidature : 23 mars 2025Type de contrat : CDIContacts : Leonardo LINGUAGLOSSA, linguaglossa@telecom-paris.fr ,Jean-Louis ROUGIER rougier@telecom-paris.frDescription de poste complète iciNous recrutons sur la base des compétences, sans distinction d'origine, d'âge ou de sexe, et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes handicapées.

title: Junior supporttekniker
description: Your tasks In the role of support technician at SAAB, you will have various tasks. It is a technical support in a primary Windows environment and in the first area you will be the filter, what is usually the classic first line on a service desk. Here you receive calls, solve cases and document in detail. Within the Backoffice, you only receive calls in the event of major operational disruptions and therefore have the opportunity to work a little more undisturbed and immerse yourself in technology and various problems. It therefore provides good opportunities to develop your skills which you can take advantage of when you next man the front.In the area of ​​"Request fulfillment" you will work with orders such as may require physical laying on of hands. Much has been automated regarding orders, but some steps simply have to be done by a person. Your profile and qualifications You who are looking for this position enjoy a role where you get to take a lot of personal responsibility and like the variety of working in the three different roles. You are verbal and like service. With a positive attitude, you accept, and solve, the problems and challenges you encounter in the role. Furthermore, you care about providing first-class service and always putting the customer in focus. We would like you to have: Completed high school education, preferably with a specialization in IT / technology. A desire to work with remote service and help people with technical problems. Good knowledge of Swedish and English - in speech and writing. Good knowledge of Windows. What we offer We help you reach your personal goals. We believe that all our employees should continue to develop at all times, regardless of whether they are juniors or have a few years under their belt. That's why we offer all our consultants qualified training and certifications in the latest technology. And that's not all - as a consultant, you can also set up an individual education plan based on your special areas of interest, where we take the bill for both study materials and certifications. With us at Centric, you quickly get into the community through our internal and external activities where we meet and come up with something fun together. title: Oceanographic Technician
description: About VOTO/Ocean Knowledge The non-profit foundation Voice of the Ocean (VOTO) aims to increase public and scientific knowledge of the health of the oceans, specifically focusing on the Baltic Sea and connected seas. The Ocean Knowledge branch of VOTO, based in Gothenburg, focuses on supporting marine research and the research community through our infrastructure and expertise. We operate marine technology, collect scientific data and develop methodologies with all work openly available to the wider community. Our infrastructure includes 13 underwater gliders, four autonomous surface vessels, a micro AUV and two ROVs, as well as access to three 25m vessels equipped for research and survey work located around the Baltic and Kattegat.Ocean Knowledge is adding an oceanographic technician to the team for technical and scientific support and to ensure the best possible data collection and operation. Oceanographic Technician The oceanographic technician will join our team in Gothenburg, working both in the workshop and on our vessels handling and maintaining scientific instruments and autonomous platforms. This includes a wide range of tasks such as configuration, calibration, deployment and recoveries, sampling, basic data management, monitoring, fault-finding, repairs and service.Specifically, some of the tasks will include: As required, travel domestically and internationally to support fieldwork around the Baltic Sea.Validate, document and configure scientific instruments. Maintain, fault-find and repair our fleet of Gliders, ASVs, AUVs, ROVs and sampling equipment.Prepare and document missions.Requirements: The duties of the technician (including fieldwork, monitoring and at sea) will require out of hours work and travel domestically and internationally up to 50 days per year. Experience with handling scientific instrumentation and/or survey equipment and data.Willingness to learn and develop skills in both technical and oceanographic aspects of scientific sensors, gliders and other autonomous vehicles Motivated and driven team player, willing to work night/weekends on a scheduled basis Experience working at sea.Interest in oceanography and marine environments.Driver's licenseBeneficial Skills: Background in academia and practical oceanography work, sampling and lab work.Experience with marine biological/chemical/biogeochemical sampling methods.Someone who is actively interested in finding, following and developing best practices and protocols for at-sea water sampling.Someone who is interested in finding the best solutions to answer scientific questions; collaborating with the team to think outside the box.Experience with larger research vessel operations.Experience with AUVs, ASVs, ROVs or Ocean GlidersExperience with hydrographic surveyingExperience with oceanographic sensorsExperience with oceanography or similar marine scienceIt's important to us to build a supportive and diverse team with people who share our values to promote curiosity for the oceans and to work towards a better future. If you think this is you, but you maybe don't fulfil all of the requirements, please still get in touch with us and we encourage you to apply!Work environmentThe Ocean Knowledge team is a close knit team of 12 working from the VOTO office in Gothenburg. We have a supportive and driven work environment, where we encourage all team members to innovate, push for our shared goals and problem solve together. It has taken good teamwork to set up and maintain our ocean observatories, and we learn from each other's strengths.ApplicationsThe position is based in Gothenburg, Sweden. Applicants are expected to have the ability to live and work in the EU.For further information, or to apply, please submit your CV and a cover letter by e-mail to Anna Willstrand Wranne at oceanknowledge@voiceoftheocean.org by 31 January 2025.

description: Nobina is the Nordic region's largest and most experienced operator in public transport. Our success creates a better society in the form of increased mobility, reduced environmental impact and lower societal costs. Read more at www.nobina.se We are now looking for an IT specialist interested in technology who wants to work with advanced bus technology for our new traffic area Nacka/Värmdö. As an IT technician with a vehicle focus at Nobina, you get a central role in installing, servicing and developing modern IT systems in our modern buses We lead the development in public transport with our innovative platform, Nobina Mobile Extension (NME) - a platform where all technology on board collaborates in an open and flexible IT environment. This means that you get to work with both hardware and software in a technically advanced environment. Nobina Mobile Extension is a platform where all services and all communication on board can be combined in an open and flexible environment and integrated mobile with external systems. Examples of tasks: performing service work, repairs and installations of IT systems in vehicles certain documentation of work performed within the area of ​​responsibility analyzing data from vehicle systems to optimize operations assemble and disassemble technical equipment for repair and troubleshooting have regular contact with Nobina's vehicle group and with subcontractors Train colleagues in how the systems work Personal characteristics and qualifications In this role we see that you are service oriented, take responsibility and have a representative demeanor. You are fluent in spoken and written Swedish and are flexible with good collaboration skills. As a problem solver with a sense of order, you are open to change and have a customer-oriented and social approach. You have a great interest in IT and a pedagogical ability to train others in the functioning of the systems. The business is based on employees who can manage trust, authority, take a great deal of personal responsibility and can take care of new situations in a way that brings benefits to the customers and the company. You have a great interest in IT and a pedagogical ability to train others in the functioning of the systems. Furthermore, we are looking for you who: have a technical high school education or other relevant education can handle Windows environment and IP-based networks have experience in troubleshooting IT systems and low-voltage circuits experience in installing technical equipment have a B driving license Meritorious if you have experience in assembly work in vehicles and if you have a D driving license. About the position and application The position is full-time with location in Björknäs or Charlottendal. We apply trial employment and individual salary setting. We want your application no later than February 2, 2025. We process applications continuously and therefore recommend that you apply as soon as possible. Questions regarding the recruitment process: Stefan Holmberg, Head of Maintenance, stefan.holmberg@nobina.se Why Nobina? At Nobina we are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where every employee feels valued. Our leaders take responsibility, make courageous decisions and always strive to meet the needs of our travelers and society. By being business-driven and focusing on the whole, we strive to develop our business and create sustainable solutions for today and for the future. In a coaching way, we are engaging. Our culture is based on respect, we care and take responsibility and we are constantly looking for new perspectives to drive innovation. Participate in technical workshops to ensure smooth integration of data pipelines, AI models and APIs. Quality and performance: Ensure compliance of deliverables with defined quality standards (model accuracy, pipeline scalability, operational efficiency). Deliver data-driven solutions that meet customer expectations in terms of business value, while guaranteeing robustness and maintainability. Guarantee strategic alignment between the client's objectives and the solutions delivered. Expertise in data and AI: Good understanding of tools and concepts related to data and AI: data pipelines, machine learning, big data, data visualization, cloud computing (Azure, AWS, GCP). Familiarity with methodologies and frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, or equivalents. Understanding of concepts such as data lakes, ETL pipelines, or the industrialization of AI models.   Product management skills: Ability to translate business needs into clear and achievable data-driven solutions. Knowledge of KPIs specific to the data field (quality of models, precision, processing cost, calculation time, ROI of AI projects).   Excellent communication: able to popularize complex concepts for non-technical stakeholders. Proficiency in professional English to interact with international clients and teams. Advantages: Agile certification (Scrum Product Owner, SAFe, etc.). Experience in the use or management of BI tools (PowerBI, Tableau) or data visualization. An organization of our development teams by expertise, promoting continuous learning, knowledge sharing and alignment with the best market standards. Real support for their career, with a manager there to help them progress and enable them to manage all situations, successes and failures alike. title: Technical Consultant (ServiceNow ITOM)
description:
About the Company
SingularLogic, a Space Hellas Group member, is a leading Enterprise Software and Digital Integrated Solutions and Services provider for large enterprises and organizations of the Private and Public sectors.
About the Role
We are seeking motivated and skilled Technical Consultants to join SingularLogic highly skilled ServiceNow consulting practice. As a member of our team, you will contribute to the implementation and optimization of IT Operations Management (ITOM) solutions for large-scale Public and Private Sector projects. The successful candidate will participate in designing, implementing, and maintaining ITOM modules such as CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and Cloud Management, providing impactful solutions that meet our clients’ business needs.
This is a unique opportunity for System Engineers, Network Engineers, or related IT professionals with a passion for IT operations and a willingness to specialize in the ServiceNow platform.
Responsibilities

Requirement Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements, analyze existing IT operations processes, and translate these into comprehensive ITOM solutions.
Solution Implementation: Configure and deploy ServiceNow ITOM modules, including Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and Orchestration. Develop and maintain Configuration Management Databases (CMDB) to ensure accurate and reliable asset and configuration data.
Technical Problem-Solving: Troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges during implementation, leveraging ServiceNow best practices to ensure optimal performance and scalability.
Client Collaboration: Provide technical expertise and clear guidance to clients, ensuring effective communication of project goals, progress, and challenges.
Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about the latest ServiceNow releases and innovations. Leverage new features to enhance ITOM capabilities and optimize implementations for better efficiency and performance.
Stakeholder Relationships: Build trusted partnerships with clients by understanding their business objectives and delivering impactful, tailored solutions.

Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (Master’s Degree is a plus).
Required Skills

Operating Systems: Linux/Unix, Windows.
Networking: LAN/WAN, TCP/IP protocols, DHCP, DNS, VPN, Firewalls, and related technologies.
Cloud Infrastructure: Cloud-native environments and tools for cloud discovery.
Virtualization: Working experience with virtualization platforms.
Web Services: Understanding of REST, SOAP, XML, and JSON.
Scripting Languages: Familiarity with scripting languages such as PERL, JavaScript, Python, or Shell.
Relational Databases: Proficiency in MySQL, MSSQL, Oracle, or similar.

Preferred Skills

Relevant certifications (e.g., CISCO Certifications, ITIL, ServiceNow certifications).
ITIL knowledge.
Hands-on experience with the ServiceNow platform.
Understanding of the CMDB lifecycle, including discovery, service mapping, and CI data integrity.
Knowledge of the Common Service Data Model (CSDM).

Soft Skills

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Very good knowledge of English language.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
Customer-oriented mindset, with the ability to build rapport and trust with stakeholders.
Team player with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and manage tight deadlines.

We offer

Attractive remuneration package (depending on experience)
Personal Development & Training programs/Certifications
Laptop and relevant equipment
Private health insurance
Friendly working environment
Work/life balance
Opportunity to develop your career and skills by joining complex and large projects
Hybrid work model

All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.

title: IT Operations Engineer
description: Imagine a career where every day brings the joy of giving back and the promise of a bright future. At Careium, that's our reality. Here, your work directly supports the incredible seniors who built the foundation of our society. It's a chance to show your gratitude, share your skills, and light up their lives - a deeply rewarding experience that leaves a lasting impact. But the journey doesn't end there. As you contribute to their well-being, you're also investing in your own future self. By developing valuable skills, building a fulfilling career, and being part of a supportive work family, you're laying the groundwork for your own golden years. Here, you're not just building a career, you're building a future where you can flourish as a senior yourself.Role OverviewWe are seeking a skilled and motivated IT Operations Engineer to join our team, with a strong focus on networking, VPN technologies, incident management and cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have experience in AWS and cloud infrastructure. You will play a crucial role in ensuring that our alarm data/traffic is transmitted reliably and securely, making sure all alarms get through without fail.Key Responsibilities:•  Design, implement, and manage secure VPN environments within a cloud infrastructure, ensuring seamless connectivity and transmission of alarm data across various business units over mobile networks. •  Develop and maintain network infrastructure on AWS to ensure high performance, security, and reliability for alarm data traffic, with a focus on mobile connectivity. •  Be part of the incident response team •  Automate monitoring and infrastructure management using modern IT/DevOps tools and methodologies within AWS to support critical alarm data flow over mobile networks. •  Monitor network performance and troubleshoot issues to ensure optimal uptime and efficiency, with a robust focus on the integrity of alarm data delivery, especially through mobile networking. •  Keep up with industry trends and advancements in IT Operations, mobile networking, and VPN technologies and evaluate their potential impact on current systems with respect to alarm data integrity. •  Drive incidents and problems within the connectivity area and its suppliers (ie SIM, mobility).•  Work closely with R&D DevOps organization during deployment of critical applications and services.Who are you and what are your qualifications?•  Proven experience as a IT Operations Engineer or in a similar role, with a focus on networking, VPN, AWS environments, and mobile networks. •  Experience of incident management processes and tools•  Strong knowledge of AWS services and architecture, including experience with network protocols and technologies, particularly regarding mobile data networks. •  Proficient in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) and experience in automation tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, Kubernetes) with AWS integrations. •  Experience with VPN technologies and tools (e.g., OpenVPN, IPSec). •  Understanding of security and compliance principles in cloud and mobile environments, especially concerning sensitive data like alarm traffic.Skills we would love to see:•  Experience with mobile networking and SIM card technologies.•  Knowledge of monitoring tools and log management (e.g., Prometheus, ELK Stack, Grafana) within AWS, focusing on alarm data traffic through mobile networks.•  Certification in relevant technologies (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS certified network specialty).What awaits you at Careium?You will be based in our bright HQ office in central Malmö, working alongside great colleagues with strong team spirit, always supporting each other through challenges and ensuring we have a good time while delivering. At Careium, we take work-life balance seriously; we apply hybrid working practices that enable our colleagues to flexibly switch between remote and onsite work.Join us and make a difference for those who raised us-and for your future self.Who are we?Careium is a leading company in technology-enabled care. We make a significant difference in people´s lives using cutting-edge technology. From social alarms and fall sensors to smoke detectors and secure communication with the alarm centre: We are one of the few players offering a complete digital alarm chain. Our overall objectives are clear. We aim to be the preferred partner and knowledge leader in our markets and a driving player in changing the market for technology-enabled care.Did we pique your interest?We'd love to hear from you if you have what it takes to be an Everyday Hero. If you would like to work in a business that saves lives and adds value to individual's lives, then get in touch. title: Head of Customer Systems
description: We're looking for a highly engaged and technically skilled manager to lead our Customer Systems team. This is a substitute position covering parental leave from October 2025 to December 2026, with the possibility of extended employment.The Customer Systems team is primarily responsible for operating and monitoring our in-house developed applications, which are hosted in our on-premise environment, as well as our Oracle and MySQL databases.The responsibilities of the role include: Monitoring and operating on-premise hosted, in-house developed applications Managing Oracle and MySQL databases Project management for small, medium, and large-sized projects  Everything must work like a well-oiled machine, 24/7/365. We operate on a modern and efficient platform that we continuously invest in. Customer Systems is part of IT Operations, which is responsible for everything from IT Support to Infrastructure, System Management, Automation, Access Management, and Business Continuity Management (BCM).About the roleAs the Head of Customer Systems, you will lead two teams and report directly to the Head of IT Operations. You will also be a key member of the IT Operations management team, where your broad contributions will be highly valued.Managing critical systems demands a high degree of responsibility, excellent communication skills, and strong collaboration with colleagues across all parts of the business. Drawing on your experience in mission-critical environments, you'll share technical knowledge and support your team in daily decision-making.Furthermore, this position involves managing various IT projects. During 2026, the role will likely be a 50/50 split between team management and leading these projects. You are expected to quickly get an overview of each project, identify key stakeholders, and effectively communicate and collaborate with all necessary parties. Having experience from cloud migration related projects is very meriting.About youWe're looking for a person with a strong interest in technology and experience in leading technical teams. You must also have solid experience managing IT-related projects. We believe you have at least five years of leadership experience. You are a great communicator with a true interest in building relationships and achieving results through your team.You have a naturally embedded risk awareness in your daily decision-making. You will push for improvements and aren't afraid to make tough decisions, all while maintaining a high level of system availability. As an engaged leader, you continuously inspire and lead by example.What we offerWe offer you the opportunity to work in a Nordic environment with a strong focus on delivery, product development and technology. Our ambitions are high and you will embark on a fast and challenging journey together with a skillful team of sharp and committed colleagues. Our teams are autonomous and embrace the agile way of working.Culture is built and cared for, each day by everyone. We're proud of ours. Having a flat organization where anyone can talk to anyone creates a warm and friendly atmosphere worth protecting. We believe in a culture where every effort counts and where everyone is being recognized. A culture embracing our core values - passion, simplicity and transparency on all levels, no matter who you are or what you do.We are over 900 employees in Stockholm, Oslo, Helsinki and Copenhagen.ApplicationIf you have questions, please contact Alva Hellberg, Talent Acquisition Partner, at alva.hellberg@nordnet.se.Please note that we do only accept applications through our recruitment system, hence no email applications will be considered.We want to inform you that Nordnet conducts mandatory credit and background checks, as well as drug testing as a part of our recruitment process.We look forward to receiving your application!
